label: 冒险特定行动 Adventure Specific Actions

Play the Fool.name: Play the Fool
Play the Fool.description:
You play a card in the mystical game of fey fool with Ded Bolota and Ded Bereza, empowering your attack with your own skills, based on the suit you selected. Choose the suit of spring, summer, fall, or winter. For spring, attempt an Acrobatics, Nature, or Performance check. For summer, attempt an Arcana, Diplomacy, or Society check. For fall, attempt an Athletics, Deception, or Religion check. For winter, attempt an Intimidation, Occultism, or Survival check. The outcome depends on your check result.

A PC trained in Games Lore can roll using Games Lore for any of the suits instead of using one of the listed skills. The first time a given PC does this, the DC is 5 lower. The GM might allow similar Lore skills to work the same way.

Critical Success You gain 2 Victory Points.

Success You gain 1 Victory Point.

Failure The fey gain 1 Victory Point.

Critical Failure The fey gain 2 Victory Points.

Flickering Figure.name: Flickering Figure
Flickering Figure.description:
Frequency once per day

You transform your body so it appears to grow translucent, so that your appearance shimmers and blends with your surroundings. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} and can use this concealment to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}. This effect lasts for 10 minutes.

Repository of Knowledge.name: 知识宝库 Repository of Knowledge
Repository of Knowledge.description:
性相 心智

你的遗物充满了过往时代的精神刻印。当你携带圣物的时候，你将获得额外三种受训的学识技能，具体由GM根据圣物的历史来选择，并在获得此赋礼的时候决定。在圣物9级时，这些额外学识技能提升为专家熟练度，在圣物17级时，这些额外学识技能提升到大师熟练度。

Fight Fires.name: 灭火 Fight Fires
Fight Fires.description:
你尝试灭火，踩踏着火的碎屑、扑灭较小的火焰、或者将还未燃烧的物品搬离火焰。尝试@Check[acrobatics|dc:15]、@Check[athletics|dc:15]或@Check[survival|dc:15]检定，并根据你的等级来判断成功度。若你在进行该动作的过程中用了水的话，则会在检定中获得+2物品加值。另外，你也能够在施法中尝试法术攻击检定来使用法术灭火，不过你需要向GM描述你会如何使用法术灭火，GM 将会判断该计划是否有成功的可能性。若法术具有[水]特征，可以自动给予大成功结果或者立即熄灭火焰。

大成功 你获得2点灭火点数

成功 你获得1点灭火点数

大失败 你失去1点灭火点数

Fire the Cannons! (5-6).name: Fire the Cannons! (5-6)
Fire the Cannons! (5-6).description:
You help the Unsinkable's crew to fire the ship's cannons at the manifestation of Qxal. The cannons can fire either cannonballs or harpoons at a range of 100 feet. Attempt an [[/r {1d20+17} #Attack roll]]{attack roll with a +17 bonus} against the manifestation.

Critical Success As a success, but the manifestation takes double damage. If hit by a harpoon, the manifestation is pulled 30 feet toward the Unsinkable.

Success The manifestation takes @Damage[(4d8+7)[bludgeoning]] damage if hit by a cannonball or takes @Damage[(2d8+3)[piercing]] damage and is pulled 15 feet toward the Unsinkable if hit by a harpoon.

Failure The attack deals no damage.

Critical Failure The attack deals no damage and the cannon can't be fired again on the next round.

Shattered Earth.name: 破碎之地 Shattered Earth
Shattered Earth.description:
性相 土

启动 2 命令，交互

频率 每小时一次

效果 S你圣物发出的地震脉冲在附近的地面上激起涟漪，让地面冒出许多尖刺。60尺内的一片半径为10尺的石头或泥土会成为困难地形。在移动动作期间进入效果范围内的生物必须通过1次特技检定或反射检定，否则受到@Damage[1d6[piercing]]伤害；每次移动即使穿过了多个受影响的方格，也只需进行1次检定。在6级时，并且之后每升4级，伤害都会增加1d6。

Searing Wave.name: Searing Wave
Searing Wave.description:
Aspect fire

Activate 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Effect You allow a portion of the fire magic housed in your relic to escape in a direction of your choice. You deal @Damage[1d10[fire]] damage for every 2 levels of the relic to all creatures in a @Template[cone|distance:30] (@Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic]). You can't use Searing Wave again for [[/r 1d4 #Recharge Searing Wave]] rounds.

Position the Hunters.name: Position the Hunters
Position the Hunters.description:
With the target game animals located, you must move to an advantageous position without startling the prey. Attempt a Stealth check.

  • Against an impressive and dangerous find: @Check[stealth|dc:25]
  • Against standard game: @Check[stealth|dc:20]
  • Against river turtles, bats, and lesser game: @Check[stealth|dc:15]

Critical Success The animals have no indication that they are in danger, and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to rolls made during the hunting phase.

Success You position yourself well and take no penalty when Hunting.

Failure Your loud and clumsy movements alert the animals to your presence, and you take a -2 circumstance penalty to rolls made during the hunting phase.

Critical Failure You stumble loudly and startle the majority of the animals, which escape and leave the party with very few animals to catch. The party loses 2 IP.

Practical Research.name: 实践研究 Practical Research
Practical Research.description:
需求 你是上级生（conversant）或讲师（lore-speaker）

你在某个领域里发现了一些有趣的东西，并对其进行专门的研究。这需要一个适当的技能检定，当这种机会出现时，GM会进行描述。检定的结果各不相同。虽然结果通常都会为你带来学术上的好处，但是一些实践研究也能提供一些独特的好处，例如将会给你的角色开启一些新的角色选项。

Perform a Trick.name: 表演把戏 Perform a Trick
Perform a Trick.description:
你表演你的马戏团招牌把戏。尝试与你的把戏相关的一个把戏检定。把戏检定的DC由你的等级决定。每个把戏检定的结果决定你是否能产生兴奋值、期待值，或是失去他们。

大成功 你产生的兴奋值相当于该把戏的等级；这个兴奋值将被添加到马戏团的总兴奋值中。你还会产生相当于该把戏等级一半的期待值（向上取整）；这种期待值会被添加到马戏团的总期待值中。

成功 你产生的兴奋值相当于该把戏的等级；这个兴奋值将被添加到马戏团的总兴奋值中。

失败 无效果。

大失败 马戏团的兴奋值减少了把戏等级的一半（向上取整）。

你可以在每幕剧中多次进行表演把戏，并且为每次尝试选择不同的把戏检定。如果你在同一剧幕中表演了两次把戏，你的第二次把戏检定将受到 -5 减值。如果你表演了三次把戏，第三次检定有 -10 减值。如果你的把戏具有灵巧特征，则减值会分别减少到 -4 和 -8。

这个动作总是具有马戏团特征。从1级开始，你可以为你的招牌把戏选择一个额外的把戏特征，并将其也应用于这个动作。随着你等级的提高，你可以增加额外的特征。

Little Ripple's Blessing.name: Little Ripple's Blessing
Little Ripple's Blessing.description:
Frequency once

You tap into your bond with Little Ripple to temporarily manifest the water elemental. A sphere of semi-tangible water surrounds you, which magically purifies your spirit and purges toxins from your body. Little Ripple attempts to counteract a single disease or poison you are affected by with a counteract modifier of [[/r 1d20+21 #Counteract]]{+21} and a counteract rank of 10. Little Ripple's presence has a soothing effect on your spirit. You gain a +1 status bonus to Will saves for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.campaign-effects.Item.GBaN8XZrzFp7C7fL]{Effect: Little Ripple's Blessing}

Smooth the Path.name: Smooth the Path
Smooth the Path.description:
Requirement The PC has successfully infiltrated the estate.

Now that they're on the inside, the PC helps an ally who's still trying to infiltrate. They describe what they're doing to help, and give the ally the benefits of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tfa4Sh7wcxCEqL29]{Following the Expert}. The GM might require the PC to attempt a relevant skill check (typically DC 32) to Smooth the Path.

Approach Duneshadow.name: Approach Duneshadow
Approach Duneshadow.description:
Once the PCs have Tracked Duneshadow, they begin intermittently sighting him atop distant hills, hear his bellowing calls, or sense other signs that he's near. The camel is remarkably cunning and stealthy, able to exploit heat shimmers to hide his movements, predict hunters' next steps, and make exceptional use of the terrain. All the while, his path leads the PCs farther into the foothills of the Brazen Peaks.

An attempt to Approach Duneshadow is a slow and deliberate activity that takes 1 hour to perform, during which each PC attempts a skill check chosen from the following options: @Check[acrobatics|dc:37] or @Check[athletics|dc:37] (to approach quickly via a shortcut), @Check[deception|dc:38] (to trick Duneshadow into evading pursuit in the wrong direction), @Check[nature|dc:35] (to keep Duneshadow calm and appear non-threatening), @Check[performance|dc:34] (to intrigue Duneshadow with calming music), or @Check[stealth|dc:36] (to approach undetected). Lore skills can be substituted for any of these skills, reducing the DC by 2. To reach Duneshadow, the party must successfully Approach four times. Critical successes count as two successes, and critical failures negate one success. If this reduces the total to two or fewer, Duneshadow runs off and the PCs must Scout for his location all over again.

Forge Documents.name: 伪造文件 Forge Documents
Forge Documents.description:
Overcome @Check[society|dc:34]

The PC prepares several forgeries that might serve as convincing props during the heist.

Success The PC creates convincing documents that grant the PCs 1 Edge Point they can use when presenting proper credentials, work orders, or invitations.

Failure The PC creates somewhat unconvincing documents. Inform the PCs the forgeries grant 1 Edge Point. However, when they use that Edge Point, it grants no benefit.

Critical Failure As failure, but a PC who uses the Edge Point on a failure gets a critical failure instead.

Grudge.name: Grudge
Grudge.description:
Your hatred is so powerful that it can overwhelm another's mind. Choose a creature within 30 feet of you that's aware of you. That creature sees your expression suddenly transform into a supernaturally distorted visage of hatred and must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save. Since this perception of your hatred is all perceived directly in the target's mind, it doesn't have the visual trait—if the target can't see you, your hatred manifests in different ways that the target will have no problem observing. Perhaps your voice manifests as a sinister whisper in their ears, or maybe you flood them with a scent that invokes a horrific memory. The creature is then immune to Grudge for 24 hours.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}

Failure The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}, falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} from the shock, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} as long as it remains frightened.

Critical Failure The creature faints from fear, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}. As soon as it's no longer unconscious it becomes frightened 2 and is fleeing as long as it remains frightened.

Investigate Chamber.name: Investigate Chamber
Investigate Chamber.description:
You take 10 minutes to investigate a specific room in the Golden Citadel to learn any information about it. Guards won't normally be annoyed by this if you investigate a public area, but if they see you investigating a private area they will attempt to escort you out before you can complete the investigation. Attempt a @Check[perception|dc:36] to determine your level of success.

Critical Success You learn the room's read-aloud text, basic information, and any secret information.

Success You learn the room's read-aloud text and basic information.

Failure You fail to learn anything about the room other than its read-aloud text.

Critical Failure As failure above, but any guards who can observe you notice suspicious activity and attempt to escort you out of the area, either to the council chamber or out of the building entirely.

(Affinity Ablaze) Speakers to the Winds:.name: (Affinity Ablaze) Speakers to the Winds: All is One, One is All
(Affinity Ablaze) Speakers to the Winds:.description:
Frequency once per day

There are few bonds like those between fighters who have shared blows in an arena, and in so doing, come to understand each other. You focus on your emotional connection to one of the other tournament teams, and their power roars along it to you like a string set alight. You use the following ability, which you must have gained access to from the original team.

Borrowing the magic of the Magaambya, you use a legendary spell from Old-Mage Jatembe himself. You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gtWxTfMbIN5RHQw6]{All is One, One is All} as a 9th-rank arcane or primal innate spell.

Restore the Orrery.name: 修复天球仪 Restore the Orrery
Restore the Orrery.description:
你尝试将 暗星 碎片归位至光明天球仪内的适当位置。如此做需要进行 DC 18 的技能检定。你可以尝试 @Check[athletics|dc:18] 检定将碎片强行放回适当位置；@Check[arcana|dc:18]、@Check[nature|dc:18]、@Check[occultism|dc:18] 或 @Check[religion|dc:18] 检定使碎片调和于天球仪的魔法；或 @Check[thievery|dc:18] 检定改造天球仪机构以接受碎片。你能归还的碎片数量取决于你的结果。

大成功 你将 4 块碎片归还至天球仪。

成功 你将 2 块碎片归还至天球仪。

失败 你只能归还 1 块碎片至天球仪。

大失败 你无法取得任何进展，未归还任何碎片至天球仪。

Send in the Clowns.name: 小丑入场 Send in the Clowns
Send in the Clowns.description:
需求 你或其他表演者在当前幕剧中的把戏检定失败或大失败。

你发出信号，让马戏团的小丑们上台，拯救搞砸的把戏。能将一个失败的把戏改为成功，或者如果它是一个大失败，则改为失败。小丑在每场幕剧中只能被派出场一次，而且只能影响一次把戏检定。

Costar.name: 共演 Costar
Costar.description:
触发 另一位与你在相同幕剧的表演者即将进行把戏检定。

需求 表演者愿意接受你的协助。

你帮助另一个表演者完成他们的把戏，可能会给他们带来触发把戏检定的加值。尝试进行与你试图协助的把戏相同的检定。 共演的DC等于把戏检定的DC。 NPC不能进行共演。这个反应的作用与@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]动作相同。

Make General Repairs.name: Make General Repairs
Make General Repairs.description:
Requirements Crafting (trained), Specialty Crafting (woodworking), or hired woodworker; organized workers

You make general repairs to the citadel furnishings, replacing or fixing furniture, replacing rotted floorboards, and rehanging doors throughout the structure. This task takes 14 days of work and a @Check[crafting|dc:15] check.

Rebuild Collapsed Stairs.name: Rebuild Collapsed Stairs
Rebuild Collapsed Stairs.description:
Requirements Crafting (expert), Specialty Crafting (stonemasonry), or hired stonemason; organized workers

You work to clear rubble and rebuild the stairs connecting citadel floors, requiring a @Check[crafting|dc:20] check. Repairing the stairs from the courtyard to the battlement (connecting areas A12 and A22) takes 4 days. Repairing the stairs from the courtyard to the vault (connecting areas A12 and B1) takes 4 days. Digging out the long flight of stairs down to Alseta's Ring (connecting areas B1 and D7) takes 8 days.

Elemental Attack.name: 元素攻击 Elemental Attack
Elemental Attack.description: 从气，土，火，金，水，木中选择一项（此选择一旦你为模仿者作出便不能改变）。无面鬼模仿者以60尺内一个生物为目标，制造一道该种元素的爆炸；该生物受到@Damage[4d6[@item.flags.system.rulesSelections.damage]]挥砍（气），钝击（土，水，木），穿刺（金），或火焰（火）伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic]豁免）。元素攻击获得相应元素特征。

Dream Research.name: 梦中研究 Dream Research
Dream Research.description:
触发 你在夏尔文庄园5 英里范围内睡着了。

频率 每12 小时一次

当你入眠时，你会经历那些近乎梦魇一般的噩梦。在这些梦里，你感觉你的心智被从灵魂中抽离，你所知的一切都仿佛被星辰间黑暗的宇宙吞噬。在梦境里，你可以专注于某个尚未研究完成的课题。如果队友在梦中研究完了这个课题，你可以立即切换为另一个课题。

你所使用的技能和DC 依据每个课题而有所不同，详见每个课题的梦境节点。如果你不是在庄园内部做梦，和咒怨的心灵连接就会变弱，你的研究检定会承受-2 减值。

大成功 你获得2 RP。

成功 你获得1 RP。

大失败 你对咒怨的探究过于深入了，它已盯上了你。在你的一部分记忆被它贪婪地吞噬之前，你必须设法打破心灵连接。你的咒怨状态值上升1 点。

Chained Charge.name: Chained Charge
Chained Charge.description: You Stride and then make a tusk Strike at the end of your movement. If you move farther than 15 feet from your chained allies, you pull them along to the nearest open space 15 feet behind you. The creature you hit must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:35] save or fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Forgive Foe.name: 宽恕敌人 Forgive Foe
Forgive Foe.description:
你试图迫使一名敌人直面自己的愧疚，并为自己的行为而感到羞愧。当你这么做时，尝试一次@Check[diplomacy|defense:will]检定或该生物羞愧条目中所指示的其他检定；该DC为该生物的意志DC。

大成功 你的言辞直切要害、一针见血，并且允许该生物逃离时间边缘之屋的奴役。具体效果会在该生物的羞愧条目中列出。

成功 你的言辞让敌人身形一顿。它在所有攻击、效果DC和对抗额外的宽恕敌人尝试的意志DC中承受-2状态减值，直至你的下一回合结束。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.campaign-effects.Item.tWFcPYueuOdSgSgg]

大失败 你过于戏剧性的失败反而激发了该生物的愤怒，有效地蒙蔽了他的羞愧感和内疚感。在接下来的24小时中，当他在攻击你时不会再承受羞愧的效果，并且你也无法再试图宽恕这名敌人。

Communicate From Beyond.name: Communicate From Beyond
Communicate From Beyond.description:
Requirements Students are present to witness your attempt to communicate. There are appropriate means of communication, such as items of negligible Bulk to manipulate, powder to write in, or lights to make a pattern.

You try to communicate a simple message to the students from your phase of reality. Attempt a

Levels 1-2

  • @Check[athletics|dc:15],
  • @Check[diplomacy|dc:15]
  • @Check[occultism|dc:15], or
  • @Check[thievery|dc:15] check

Levels 3-4

  • @Check[athletics|dc:18],
  • @Check[diplomacy|dc:18]
  • @Check[occultism|dc:18], or
  • @Check[thievery|dc:18]

with the following results.

Critical Success You communicate a phrase of up to 10 words.

Success You clearly communicate one word to the students.

Failure The students cannot understand your communications.

Critical Failure The students misinterpret your message, gaining incorrect information determined by the GM.

Perception Filter.name: 察觉过滤 Perception Filter
Perception Filter.description:
性相 心智

启动 2 想象

频率 每日一次

效果 你的圣物能过滤附近所有生物的心智，阻止对方意识到你的存在。在接下来的10分钟里，一个进入以你为中心@Template[emanation|distance:120]范围内的生物，必须尝试一次@Check[will|against:class-spell|traits:secret]检定，在这之后该生物对此效果临时免疫1天。

大成功 生物不受影响

成功 生物在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]或侦测你的时候，察觉检定有-2状态减值

失败 生物的所有感官被你过滤，让它很难注意到你。当你对该生物具有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]或无踪状态时，即使你进行潜行、躲藏、快步以外的其他动作，你也不会暴露。如果它试图以察觉检定对你进行搜索或侦测，则检定结果会下降一个成功级别。如果你尝试以隐秘检定进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]或其他任何避免引起注意的行动，你的检定结果会提高一个成功级别。如果你对目标采取具有敌意的动作，对该生物的效果在你具有敌意的动作完成后结束。

大失败 同失败，但是你对目标生物进行具有敌意的动作不会导致效果结束

Fey Luck.name: 精类幸运 Fey Luck
Fey Luck.description:
触发 你在一次豁免骰中失败或大失败

频率 一次

在将小精灵从残忍的笼子中释放出来后，你所获得的运气将使你免遭不幸的命运。将失败的豁免骰调整为成功，或者将大失败的豁免骰调整为失败。

(Affinity Ablaze) Biting Roses: Glimpses.name: (Affinity Ablaze) Biting Roses: Glimpses to Beyond
(Affinity Ablaze) Biting Roses: Glimpses.description:
Frequency once per day

There are few bonds like those between fighters who have shared blows in an arena, and in so doing, come to understand each other. You focus on your emotional connection to one of the other tournament teams, and their power roars along it to you like a string set alight. You use the following ability, which you must have gained access to from the original team.

You gain a sense for the supernatural and the flow of fate. For 1 hour, you gain spiritsense as a precise sense with a range of 60 feet. Spiritsense enables you to sense the spirits of creatures, including living creatures, most non-mindless undead, and haunts within the listed range. As with your hearing and other imprecise senses, you still need to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} to locate an undetected creature. As spiritsense detects spiritual essence, not physical bodies, it can detect spirits projected by spells such as project image or possessing otherwise soulless objects. It can't detect soulless bodies, constructs, or objects. Once during the spell's duration, when you roll a failure or critical failure on a saving throw or skill check, you get a success instead.

Invoke Eiseth.name: Invoke Eiseth
Invoke Eiseth.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect You attempt to demoralize Lorthact by invoking his nemesis. Attempt a @Check[deception|dc:33], @Check[intimidation|dc:33], @Check[performance|dc:33], or @Check[religion|dc:33] check. Regardless of your result, Lorthact is temporarily immune to your further attempts to Invoke Eiseth for 10 minutes, though not the attempts of others.

Critical Success Lorthact becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

Success Lorthact becomes frightened 2.

Failure Lorthact becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Critical Failure Your floundering attempt backfires and instead amuses Lorthact; he is temporarily immune to all attempts to Invoke Eiseth until the end of your next turn.

Build Training Facility.name: Build Training Facility
Build Training Facility.description:
Requirements expert in the skill listed below or hired trainer; organized specialists

Pick a room in Citadel Altaerein to serve as a training area for a single character class (you can have multiple training facilities, with each one devoted to a different class). Once complete, the training facility fills the role of a teacher when using the Retrain downtime activity for the chosen class, and reduces the time required to retrain a feat or skill increase by 2 days and the time required to retrain a class feature by 1 week. This upgrade takes 40 days of work.

Building the facility requires a DC 25 skill check using a skill depending on the class in question, as listed below. If a class lists multiple skills, the PC can choose whichever one they like (but they must be an expert in the chosen skill, as noted in the Requirements entry above).

  • Alchemist @Check[crafting|dc:25]
  • Barbarian @Check[athletics|dc:25]
  • Bard @Check[occultism|dc:25] or @Check[performance|dc:25]
  • Champion @Check[religion|dc:25]
  • Cleric @Check[religion|dc:25]
  • Druid @Check[nature|dc:25]
  • Fighter @Check[acrobatics|dc:25] or @Check[athletics|dc:25]
  • Monk @Check[acrobatics|dc:25] or @Check[athletics|dc:25]
  • Ranger @Check[athletics|dc:25], @Check[nature|dc:25], or @Check[survival|dc:25]
  • Rogue @Check[acrobatics|dc:25] or @Check[thievery|dc:25]
  • Sorcerer @Check[arcana|dc:25], @Check[nature|dc:25], @Check[occultism|dc:25], or @Check[religion|dc:25]
  • Wizard @Check[arcana|dc:25]

Seasonal Boon (Outskirt Dweller).name: 季节恩惠-郊区居民 Seasonal Boon (Outskirt Dweller)
Seasonal Boon (Outskirt Dweller).description:
频率 每个季节一次

触发 你将要掷骰先攻

效果 当前状况中的某些事触发了你的防御，让你对突然的危险迅速做出反应。你在先攻骰上获得等同于你开始《肆季鬼志》后度过的季节数量（第一场冒险+1，最大到最后第四场冒险+4）的状态加值。如果你可以给其他PC传达警告，他们也将在先攻上获得此加值。

Shootist's Draw.name: 射手快拔 Shootist's Draw
Shootist's Draw.description:
频率 每轮一次

效果 你以一个交互动作拔出@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.XyA6PKV46aNlLXOd]{手弩 Hand Crossbow}然后用它进行1次打击，或者你以一把已经上弦的、持握中的手弩进行打击，然后以一个交互动作收起它。

Haul Supplies.name: Haul Supplies
Haul Supplies.description:
You pack up as many supplies as you can carry and make your way back to Bazal's Basin with food and water. Attempt a @Check[athletics|dc:34] check to determine the amount and quality of the food you manage to haul and keep safe from being damaged in the storm. A character who uses powerful magic (such as teleport) to aid in transporting the food automatically achieves a result one category higher than they roll.

Critical Success You return with 15 Bulk of supplies.

Success You return with 10 Bulk of supplies.

Failure Some of the food was damaged in transport, and you return with only 5 Bulk of supplies.

Critical Failure All of the supplies you attempted to transport are ruined.

Appeal to Shadowy Intruders.name: Appeal to Shadowy Intruders
Appeal to Shadowy Intruders.description:
Requirements A fetchling sneak you can see is visibly shaken, such as by being reduced to half of their maximum Hit Points or fewer.

You call out to a visibly shaken foe and attempt to convince them to surrender. Depending upon your strategy, attempt a @Check[deception|defense:will], @Check[diplomacy|defense:will], or @Check[intimidation|defense:will] check against the foe's Will DC to make your case for the foe's surrender.

Critical Success The foe is quick to surrender and attempts to convince their allies to surrender as well. You and your allies gain a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to Appeal to Shadowy Intruders for 1 minute.

Success The foe takes your words to heart and surrenders to you immediately.

Failure The foe brushes off your attempt and continues to fight.

Critical Failure Your argument is severely flawed or laughable. The foe disregards your words and continues to fight. You take a -1 circumstance penalty to checks to Appeal to Shadowy Intruders for 1 minute.

Explore the Vault of Boundless Wonder.name: Explore the Vault of Boundless Wonder
Explore the Vault of Boundless Wonder.description:
Searching an area of the vault takes about 10 minutes. When you Explore the Vault of Boundless Wonder, attempt a skill check, choosing from the skills indicated in the area you're searching. Other Lore checks might be appropriate at the GM's discretion. The DC of most skill checks is 15 (DC 18 for levels 3-4); for checks using an appropriate Lore skill, lower the DC to 12 (DC 15 for levels 3-4). The overwhelming presence of magic in the vault makes detect magic and similar magic less accurate than usual, but if you use such spells, you gain a +1 status bonus to your check. Based on the results of your check, you might discover something useful.

Critical Success You make a significant discovery in the area you're searching.

Success You make a discovery in the area you're searching.

Critical Failure You make a mistaken discovery in the area you're searching.

Chilling Paralysis.name: Chilling Paralysis
Chilling Paralysis.description:
Frequency once per hour

The unnatural cold of your touch freezes muscles and locks joints, leaving your victims shivering and unable to move. Attempt a melee weapon or unarmed Strike against a target. If you hit, in addition to all the Strike's normal effects, the target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The supernatural cold causes the target to shiver and quake, making them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of their next turn.

Failure The supernatural cold paralyzes the target for 1 round, then leaves them slowed 1 for 1 round after.

Critical Failure The target becomes frozen in place by the cold and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 minute. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each attempt. Once the target recovers, it's slowed 1 for 1 round.

Organize Labor.name: Organize Labor
Organize Labor.description:
You spend a day in Breachill recruiting workers to aid in a repair or an upgrade at Citadel Altaerein. Attempt a @Check[deception|dc:13], @Check[diplomacy|dc:13], or @Check[intimidation|dc:13] check to Organize Labor to organize workers, or a @Check[deception|dc:18], @Check[diplomacy|dc:18], or @Check[intimidation|dc:18] check for specialists.

If you use Deception or Intimidation for this check, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus, but failure comes with extra risks, as detailed below. Using Diplomacy grants no bonus to the check, but comes without added risk. When you Organize Labor, you must specify one repair or upgrade activity to be undertaken; once you successfully Organize Labor, you must begin that activity within a week.

A force of organized workers costs 1 gp per day, while a force of organized specialists costs 5 gp per day.

Critical Success You organize labor for the full duration of the repair or upgrade activity, and the cost to pay the workers is halved for the duration.

Success You organize labor for the full duration of a repair or upgrade activity.

Failure You organize labor for a single day of a repair or upgrade activity. Unless you used Diplomacy, word of your deceptive or intimidating nature spreads, and you take a -1 circumstance penalty to all future checks to organize labor. This penalty increases with each subsequent failure, to a maximum penalty of -4.

Critical Failure You completely fail to organize labor. If you used Deception or Intimidation, word of your untrustworthiness or cruelty spreads, and you can no longer use that skill to Organize Labor.

Find the Cells.name: Find the Cells
Find the Cells.description:
Overcome 3 successes; @Check[architecture-lore|dc:33], @Check[perception|dc:35], @Check[survival|dc:35]

The PCs identify an efficient route through the manor and reach the holding cells and vaults in the basement-all without opening too many doors, making too much noise, or wasting time searching for secret doors.

Righteous Call.name: 正义召唤 Righteous Call
Righteous Call.description:
性相 天族赋礼

启动 2 （专注，操作）

频率 每日一次

效果 神圣的魔法充满了你的武器，使之成为对抗邪恶的真正利器。在1分钟内，你的武器和无武装攻击获得圣洁武器符文武器符文。如果一把武器的性能符文数量达到了上限，你可以选择让其中一个性能符文暂时休眠来激活圣洁符文的效果。此外，当你的盟友在你30尺范围内时，其攻击会附带圣洁特征。

Hunt the Animals.name: Hunt the Animals
Hunt the Animals.description:
When the hunt begins, the Ekujae elves and the PCs work together to bring down the game.

  • Against an impressive find, each PC actively participating (and not just Aiding) attempts a @Check[survival|dc:25] check
  • Against standard game, @Check[survival|dc:20] check
  • No check is needed to hunt river turtles or bats—hunting such game is automatically successful (but can never be a critical success).

Critical Success You help take down the animals quickly and relatively painlessly, showing them mercy.

Success Your participation in the hunt helps the hunting party take down the animals quickly.

Failure Your involvement complicates the hunt-one or two animals even escape uninjured. Each PC takes [[/r 2d6]] damage from animal attacks (or [[/r 4d6]] if the animals were an impressive find).

Critical Failure Several of the animals die poorly, and many escape with mortal wounds. Barely enough animals are caught for the feast, but the fact that they died in pain or escaped with injuries shames the Ekujae-the party loses 2 IP. Each PC takes [[/r (2d6+6)]] damage from animal attacks (or [[/r (4d6+12)]] if the animals were an impressive find).

Liralarue's Glimpse.name: Liralarue's Glimpse
Liralarue's Glimpse.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail or critically fail a saving throw or attack roll.

Requirements You aren't stupefied.

You suddenly realize that what you thought was a catastrophic failure on your part was actually a supernaturally realistic vision from your immediate future. Reroll the saving throw or attack roll that triggered this reaction. If you fail the reroll, you instead succeed. If you critically fail the reroll, you instead merely fail the roll.

Although you can use Liralarue's Glimpse once per day, if you use this reaction more than once a week, your abuse of these glimpses of the future causes you to also glimpse dreadful, unavoidable pains and dooms that you'll certainly experience in the future. These glimpses provide no additional aid or benefit, but their distracting nature causes you to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} and prevents you from using Liralarue's Glimpse again for 7 days.

Contact Steel Falcons.name: Contact Steel Falcons
Contact Steel Falcons.description:
Overcome @Check[andoran-lore|dc:32], @Check[diplomacy|dc:36], @Check[society|dc:34]

The PC surreptitiously tries to contact the Steel Falcons in Katapesh.

Success The PC arranges a meeting with the Steel Falcons. They're eager to combine forces with powerful operatives like the PCs in the name of liberating the oppressed, and they can provide information about the upcoming auction equivalent to a Gather Information success. In addition, the Steel Falcons grant the PCs 1 Edge Point.

Failure The PC fails to make contact.

Critical Failure The PC's clumsy attempt spooks the Steel Falcons. Future attempts at this activity take a -2 circumstance penalty.

Special If the PCs don't succeed at this Opportunity, the Steel Falcons independently decide to launch their own heist that overlaps with-and potentially interferes with-the PCs' heist.

Diviner on Duty.name: Diviner on Duty
Diviner on Duty.description:
Trigger A PC uses magic to aid in overcoming an Obstacle during infiltration.

Overcome 3 successes: @Check[arcana|dc:35], @Check[deception|dc:37], @Check[nature|dc:35], @Check[occultism|dc:35], @Check[religion|dc:35]

Among the Scarlet Triad's security is a highly competent diviner! With spells such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uNsliWpl8Q1JdFcM]{Discern Lies}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KHnhPHL4x1AQHfbC]{Mind Reading}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{See the Unseen}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uqlxMQQeSGWEVjki]{Truesight}, this diviner can see through most magical schemes the PCs might use.

The diviner is watching for magical threats, not poison. With a successful @Check[deception|dc:33], @Check[thievery|dc:33], or food-related Lore check, a PC can trick her into consuming something laden with an ingested poison. Her Fortitude save bonus is [[/r (1d20+23) #Fortitude Saving Throw]]{+23}, and she withdraws if successfully poisoned. If not successfully poisoned, increase the PCs' Awareness Points by 2.

Wrestle.name: Wrestle
Wrestle.description: You make a claw Strike against a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or otherwise @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by you. If you hit, you deal damage as usual and that creature is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Scout the Facility.name: Scout the Facility
Scout the Facility.description:
Overcome @Check[perception|dc:36], @Check[society|dc:38], @Check[stealth|dc:34]

The PC spends part of the day observing the Bhetshamtal Estate, recording patrols, noting escape routes, and creating a mental map.

Success The PC makes decisive observations that grant the PCs 1 Edge Point that can be used for sneaking through or navigating the estate.

Failure The PC learns nothing noteworthy.

Critical Failure The PC misjudges some element of the security. Inform the PCs that the scouting grants 1 Edge Point. When they use that Edge Point, they don't get the normal benefit, and if they rolled a normal failure they get a critical failure instead.

(Affinity Ablaze) Arms of Balance: Walki.name: (Affinity Ablaze) Arms of Balance: Walking the Cardinal Paths
(Affinity Ablaze) Arms of Balance: Walki.description:
Frequency once per day

There are few bonds like those between fighters who have shared blows in an arena, and in so doing, come to understand each other. You focus on your emotional connection to one of the other tournament teams, and their power roars along it to you like a string set alight. You use the following ability, which you must have gained access to from the original team.

The ki within you surges to coat your attacks in energy matter. For 1 minute, one of your weapons or your unarmed Strikes deal an additional 2d6 fire, cold, acid, or electricity damage. The Strikes gain the appropriate energy trait as well.

Check the Walls.name: 巡查围墙 Check the Walls
Check the Walls.description:
一名PC花费一整日时间来研究城墙并在墙上巡查。之后该PC尝试@Check[arcana|dc:32]检定或@Check[crafting|dc:27]检定。

大成功 PC 发现西侧围墙上排列着的保护符文中有一些错位——石材与魔法以不易察觉的形式错开了，该迹象是此区域长期承重的结果，但从表面上无法看出这种结果的直接成因，承重造成的形变说明这片城墙所在地区的地下某处有隐藏的空间。但不幸的是，在城市保存的记录以及建筑规划中进一步研究后，得到的结论是此区域并不存在任何地下密室，这表明要不然这片区域确实不存在密室；要不然就是密室存在，但与之相关的记录要么错误要么就是遗失了。

成功 PC 发现西侧围墙的一片区域产生了不整齐的错位——这足够证实万用榫卯佳尼斯所担心的事情，但目前还无法判明造成该错位的成因。

失败 尽管 PC 们能够识别出关于这座城市的围墙的基本信息，但他们的能力还不足以发现它在结构上的缺陷。当 PC 们向万用榫卯佳尼斯回报时，她会建议 PC 们再次巡查围墙以证实他们的怀疑，因为她认为可以从中挖出更多信息。

大失败 PC 们在东侧墙壁上发现了一处他们认为是缺陷的设计，但实际上，这只不过是古代魔法在设计时的古怪惯例而已。当 PC 们回报自己找到的内容后，万用榫卯佳尼斯会向大法师瑙鲁温确认这一情况，后者立即检查了该区域并准确地指出了 PC 们犯下的错误。这次 PC 行动的失败导致万用榫卯佳尼斯以及山脉之心凿石不会再对 PC 们在寇夫拉的行动进行支持。

Kick Dust.name: 踢起尘土 Kick Dust
Kick Dust.description:
需求 你正站在具有充足松软泥土的区域内

通过用你的脚扬起或踢起尘土，你把一团灰土扬到相邻的空间内。尝试@Check[acrobatics|dc:15]或@Check[athletics|dc:15]检定。扬起灰土的规模取决于你的检定结果。

大成功 尘土填满了@Template[cone|distance:15]区域。锥形区域内的生物在2轮内会被尘土覆盖，被尘土覆盖的生物为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]状态而非@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]状态。以1个动作，该生物能尝试@Check[reflex|dc:15]豁免来抖掉尘土。

成功 如同大成功，但是尘土会填满@Template[cone|distance:10]区域。

失败 你只踢起了些微的尘土。

大失败 你误判了踢腿的力度，这搞得你跌跌撞撞并陷入了@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]，持续至你的下个回合开始为止。

Scout Duneshadow.name: Scout Duneshadow
Scout Duneshadow.description:
Duneshadow's known to traverse a wide territory in north-central Katapesh, and the PCs first need to narrow down his current location to within a few miles. A full scouting attempt takes 4 hours, during which each PC attempts a skill check chosen from the following options, depending on how they wish to scout: @Check[diplomacy|dc:40] (to ask local nomads about sightings) or @Check[nature|dc:36] (to know about camel behavior and where Duneshadow might best be found). At your discretion, a PC can substitute an appropriate Lore skill for any of these skills, in which case the DC is reduced by 2.

To find the camel's trail, the party must successfully Scout Duneshadow three times. Critical successes count as two successes, and critical failures negate one success. If all PCs abandon this task and no one is Scouting Duneshadow, the number of accumulated successes resets to zero. Magic such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.CeSh8QcVnqP5OlLj]{Pinpoint} gives two successes toward finding Duneshadow, though he moves so often and in such odd ways that even in the 10 minutes it takes to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.69L70wKfGDY66Mk9]{Teleport}, only his trail will remain. Once they get three successes, the PCs can then @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track} him (@Check[survival|dc:40]). They need to succeed twice in a row or critically succeed once, and can try again on a failure. On a critical failure, the PCs must wait at least 24 hours before Scouting Duneshadow again.

Secure Invitation.name: Secure Invitation
Secure Invitation.description:
Overcome @Check[diplomacy|dc:35], @Check[society|dc:35]

The PC seeks out someone with an invitation they're willing to sell.

Critical Success The PC finds an invitation-holder and convinces them to give away the invitation for free. The PCs gain 1 Edge Point.

Success The PC finds someone willing to sell their invitation for 250 gp. If they pay, the group gets 1 Edge Point. They can attempt to steal it instead (@Check[thievery|dc:34]), but if they do, increase Awareness at the beginning of Phase 2: Infiltration by 2.

Failure The PC is unable to find an invitation.

Restore the Mausoleum.name: 修复陵墓 Restore the Mausoleum
Restore the Mausoleum.description:
修复陵墓的第一步是花费四天清理 A10–A12 区域、修复轻微损伤、补漆，并最重要的是清理从 A11 区域通往墓地的台阶。每位协助清理的额外玩家角色可使陵墓清理时间减少 1 天，最少 1 天。完成第一步任务无需技能检定，但若至今无人发现 A11 区域的隐藏宝藏，将在此期间自动发现。

玩家角色可以将此任务委托给当地人，但若他们亲自完成，亲手参与并花费大量时间在陵墓中工作的过程将振奋他们的精神，每位玩家角色在后续步骤的任何技能检定上获得 +1 环境加值。

陵墓清理完成后，玩家角色可花一天时间物理修复 A10 区域螺旋符文或 A11 区域雕像的损伤，或为 A10 区域的螺旋符文或 A12 区域的石棺祈求法莱斯玛的祝福。这些是 @Check[religion|dc:18] 或 @Check[crafting|dc:20] 检定，用以获取胜利点数。一旦玩家角色获得共 8 个胜利点数，法莱斯玛、阿拉兹尼及玩家角色任何信仰的神祇都将注意到他们的工作；此时陵墓已被修复并可作为祝圣仪式的焦点（此任务可能由当地祭司在日后完成），但对于任何参与修复的玩家角色而言，更直接的意义是诸神的恩宠。

陵墓修复完成后，每位玩家角色获得来自特定神祇的神圣干涉。所授效果为法莱斯玛的小恩赐，给予玩家角色一次性 +2 状态加值至单次检定，可在确定检定结果后应用（这有可能改变成功等级）。若某位特别虔诚的玩家角色信仰不同神祇，你可改为授予其神祇的小恩赐。

Build Library.name: Build Library
Build Library.description:
Requirements Crafting (master), any Lore (master), or hired bookmaker; organized specialists

Pick a single room in Citadel Altaerein to serve as a library. Once complete, the library grants a +2 circumstance bonus to skill checks made to Borrow an Arcane Spell, Create Forgery, Decipher Writing, Identify Alchemy, Identify Magic, Learn a Spell, or Recall Knowledge as long as the PC performing the action is on site. This upgrade takes 20 days of work and a @Check[crafting|dc:25] or Lore check.

Beginner's Luck.name: 新手之运 Beginner's Luck
Beginner's Luck.description:
性相 机运赋礼

启动 r 想象

频率 每日一次

触发 尝试某个你未受训的d20检定

效果 你获得你等级一半的熟练度加值，或者如果圣物达到7级，你获得和你等级相同的熟练度加值。然后，你投掷2次，选择更好的结果。这并不能让你尝试某个技能的受训动作。

Protector's Interdiction.name: 守护拦截 Protector's Interdiction
Protector's Interdiction.description:
触发 一个相邻盟友被一次攻击命中或重击

效果 你将自身介入盟友与攻击之间。攻击改为命中你，或是如果重击你的盟友则重击命中你。

River's Reflection.name: River's Reflection
River's Reflection.description: Existing between life and death can offer insights when it comes to channeling the energies of life and death. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell with the vitality or void traits, that spell's effects on living and undead targets are reversed. All void damage becomes vitality damage and vice versa. Any ability to heal living creatures or undead creatures is similarly swapped.

Repair Huntergate.name: Repair Huntergate
Repair Huntergate.description:
Prerequisites trained in Crafting or Thievery

Requirement You have the Huntergate portal key (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JCGsj7iY88o9uTP5]{Hunter's Arrowhead}).

You use the hunter's arrowhead to guide the misaligned magic of Huntergate back into the proper pathways through the stone's intricate carvings and decorations. You must attempt either a @Check[crafting|dc:24] check to Repair (in which case the hunter's arrowhead serves as the repair kit needed for this activity) or a @Check[thievery|dc:24] check to Pick a Lock (in which case the hunter's arrowhead serves as the thieves' tools needed for this activity). Regardless of the skill used, the activity takes an hour to perform, and the DC of the check is 24, with the following effects.

Critical Success Huntergate is repaired, and the vision of Dahak hazard inside of the Huntergate way station is reduced in power; reduce all of the hazard's modifiers and DCs by 2.

Success Huntergate is repaired.

Failure Huntergate is not repaired, and the character who attempted the repair becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} for 1 hour as an orange arc of magical energy lances painfully through their body. A new attempt to repair the portal cannot be made again for 24 hours.

Critical Failure As failure, but the magical backlash also deals @Damage[6d6[fire]] damage to the character attempting the repairs.

Erect Barricades.name: 设置路障 Erect Barricades
Erect Barricades.description:
可以用木材、树干、木桶、马车、垃圾、或者尖刺在墙壁上、小巷里甚至街道上的空隙中设置路障，从而防止敌人轻易进入城镇。设置路障需要进行手艺检定。可以由多名PC执行这一动作来设置多个路障。

大成功 成功设置了路障。当一支防守方军队进行防御动作时，其机动检定获得+2物品加值。路障被敌人摧毁前只能赋予2次该项加值。

成功 类似大成功，但路障只能在进行防御动作起到一次作用。

大失败 发生了灾难性的事故！不仅路障损坏了，而且尝试设置路障的PC会受到@Damage[10d6[bludgeoning]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic]豁免）。

Resist Death.name: Resist Death
Resist Death.description: Your spirit is so single-minded in its purpose that even obliteration of your transmigrated body isn't enough to stop them. The next time you're reduced to 0 Hit Points within the next 24 hours, you are instead reduced to 10 Hit Points and are exposed to soul degradation.

Fight the Fire.name: Fight the Fire
Fight the Fire.description:
You work to contain the fire. Attempt a @Check[acrobatics|dc:36] check to move quickly through the building and extinguish burning areas opportunistically, a @Check[athletics|dc:38] check to remove debris to prevent the spread of fire or haul buckets of water or sand to extinguish flames, or a @Check[diplomacy|dc:40] or @Check[intimidation|dc:40] check to organize bystanders into helping fight the fire.

Critical Success You make significant progress, allowing [[/r 1d6]]{1d6 citizens} to escape to safety on their own, and no citizens still trapped in the building perish at the end of the phase. Any checks to Rescue Citizens for the remainder of this phase gain a +2 circumstance bonus. Increase the number of phases remaining before the building collapses by 1.

Success You curtail flames in areas where citizens are still trapped. No citizens still trapped in the building perish at the end of the phase. Any checks to Rescue Citizens for the remainder of this phase gain a +1 circumstance bonus.

Failure You take @Damage[4d6[fire]] damage.

Critical Failure Your attempts to Fight the Fire accidentally spread the flames instead. You take @Damage[8d6[fire]] damage. Reduce the number of phases remaining before the building collapses by 1.

Shed Time.name: 超脱时间 Shed Time
Shed Time.description:
触发 你在一次豁免骰中失败或大失败，被一次打击命中，或是将增加你的濒死状态值

需求 你位于时间边缘之屋（包括任何娜芮莎的寓言），且正在受到螺旋法则的保护。

效果 你摆脱了当前所处的时间线，在触发的事件发生后重新回到其开始时。确切的效果取决于触发效果为何，如下所述。你不再受到螺旋法则的保护；一旦失去了这一保护，便无法再恢复。

  • 在豁免骰中失败 将触发的豁免骰的成功度从失败提升为成功，或者从大失败提升为失败。
  • 被一次打击命中 如果触发的打击是一次大成功，则将其改为成功。如果触发的打击是成功，则将其改为失败。
  • 增加濒死状态值 你失去了濒死状态值，以此取代增加你的濒死状态值。

Rallying Display.name: Rallying Display
Rallying Display.description: You roar or otherwise make a show of bestial strength. You automatically roll a success to rally the crowd to your team.

Shadow Smith.name: 阴影锻造 Shadow Smith
Shadow Smith.description:
性相 阴影

启动 1 交互

效果 你圣物聚集周围的影子，把它们扭曲成简单的武器、简单的工具或物品的形状，例如绳子或撬棍。它能持续到被用于一次单独的活动，或直到你再次使用此能力，或持续存在1分钟，以先发生的情况为准。之后它会消散。

Flare Bolt.name: Flare Bolt
Flare Bolt.description:
Aspect fire

Activate 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Effect A bolt of flames scorches out from the relic. Make a spell attack roll with your relic against a target within 30 feet. The bolt deals @Damage[1d6[fire]] damage for every 2 levels the relic has (minimum 1d6).

Critical Success The bolt deals double damage, as well as @Damage[1[persistent,fire]] damage per relic level.

Success The bolt deals full damage.

Explore the Electric Castle.name: Explore the Electric Castle
Explore the Electric Castle.description:
Rare

You make your way around and explore an area in Aslynn's fortress. When you Explore the Electric Castle, attempt a skill check, choosing from the skills indicated in the area you're searching. Other Lore checks might be appropriate at the GM's discretion. The DC of most skill checks is 23 (DC 26 for levels 9-10); for checks using an appropriate Lore skill, lower the DC to 20 (DC 23 for levels 9-10). You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Cast a Spell} instead of attempting a skill check. If you use a non-cantrip spell appropriate to the task, you earn a success; if the spell is at least 3rd rank (or 4th rank for levels 9-10), you instead earn a critical success. Examples of spells you can cast include invisibility or obscuring mist to help sneak, shape wood or shape stone to open a passage, or spider climb or dimension door to maneuver around difficult areas. Based on the results of your check, determine how long it takes to get to and explore the room.

Critical Success You reduce the time it takes by 5 minutes (to a minimum of 15 minutes).

Success You do not increase the time it takes.

Failure You increase the time it takes by 5 minutes.

Critical Failure You increase the time it takes by 10 minutes (to a maximum of 1 hour).

Mental Ward.name: Mental Ward
Mental Ward.description:
Frequency once

Trigger You fail or critically fail a saving throw against a mental effect

Effect You're unaffected by the triggering effect.

Steal Luck.name: 盗取机运 Steal Luck
Steal Luck.description:
性相 机运赋礼

启动 r 想象

频率 每日一次

触发 你或某个距离你30尺内的生物在幸运或厄运效果的影响下投掷2次d20，并且你想要得到更高的结果

效果 你偷取触发的两次掷骰中较高的那个结果；目标必须使用剩下那个作为结果。直到你下次每日准备，你在尝试对来自敌人、危害或环境的效果进行豁免时，你可以将之前偷取的结果作为你检定的结果。这么做将是一个幸运效果。如果你在下次每日准备前没有如此做，你失去你偷取的数字。

Shortcut Through the Wastes.name: Shortcut Through the Wastes
Shortcut Through the Wastes.description:
While traveling overland, you use your knowledge of the area or natural terrain to navigate and find the best possible route by taking advantage of a game trail, swift water current, or other natural shortcut. Attempt a DC 20 (DC 22 in Subtier 7-8) Nature, Scouting Lore, or relevant Lore check (such as Numeria Lore). Only one PC who uses this activity can attempt the check; others can attempt to Aid (DC 20).

Tier 1-2 Tier 3-4

@Check[nature|dc:20]

 @Check[nature|dc:22]
@Check[scouting-lore|dc:20]{Scouting Lore} @Check[scouting-lore|dc:22]
@Check[numeria-lore|dc:20]{Numeria Lore} @Check[numeria-lore|dc:22]{Numeria Lore}

Critical Success You find a path that saves huge amounts of time. Earn 2 Exploration Points.

Success You find a shortcut. Earn 1 Exploration Point.

Critical Failure You stumble into particularly treacherous terrain. Lose 1 Exploration Point.

Search the Laughing Jungle.name: Search the Laughing Jungle
Search the Laughing Jungle.description:
While traveling along a tributary of the Korir River in the Laughing Jungle, you use your knowledge of the area or natural terrain to navigate, find the best possible route, and search for signs of inhabitants. Attempt a DC 18 Nature, Scouting Lore, Society, or other relevant Lore check, such as Jungle Lore or River Lore (DC 20 for Levels 5-6).

Skill Tier 3-4 Tier 5-6
Nature @Check[nature|dc:18] @Check[nature|dc:20]
Society @Check[society|dc:18] @Check[society|dc:20]
Scouting Lore @Check[scouting-lore|dc:18] @Check[scouting-lore|dc:20]
Jungle Lore @Check[jungle-lore|dc:18] @Check[jungle-lore|dc:20]
River Lore @Check[river-lore|dc:18] @Check[river-lore|dc:20]

Critical Success You make significant progress in your search. Earn 2 Exploration Points.

Success You make some progress in your search. Earn 1 Exploration Point.

Critical Failure You make a mistake and waste time. Lose 1 Exploration Point.

Breaking and Entering.name: Breaking and Entering
Breaking and Entering.description:
Overcome @Check[acrobatics|dc:37], @Check[athletics|dc:35], @Check[nature|dc:35],@Check[stealth|dc:35], @Check[thievery|dc:35]

The PCs scale the walls, calm the guard dogs, hide from guards, and unlock gates.

Special If a PC successfully Breaks and Enters, they can attempt a @Check[perception|dc:35|traits:secret] to notice a set of keys carried by a guard or resting in a somewhat hard-to-reach area, allowing for that PC to take the Steal Keys Opportunity.

Ease Burden.name: 减轻负担 Ease Burden
Ease Burden.description:
性相 土

你的圣物从脚下的大地中汲取力量，减少你的负担。只要你的遗物在你身上，并且你站在地面上，你的超载阈值+1，最大负载+2。在6级时，并且之后每升4级，都会使你的超载阈值+1，最大负载+2。

Build Infirmary.name: Build Infirmary
Build Infirmary.description:
Requirements Crafting (master), Medicine (master), or hired medic; organized specialists

Choose a single room in Citadel Altaerein to serve as a dedicated infirmary. Once complete, the infirmary fulfills the healer's tools requirement for Medicine skill actions and grants a +2 circumstance bonus to Medicine checks made on site. This upgrade requires 20 days of work and a @Check[crafting|dc:25] or @Check[medicine|dc:25] check.

(Affinity Ablaze) Steps of the Sun: Gran.name: (Affinity Ablaze) Steps of the Sun: Grand Harmony
(Affinity Ablaze) Steps of the Sun: Gran.description:
Frequency once per day

There are few bonds like those between fighters who have shared blows in an arena, and in so doing, come to understand each other. You focus on your emotional connection to one of the other tournament teams, and their power roars along it to you like a string set alight. You use the following ability, which you must have gained access to from the original team.

Your heart harmonizes with those of your comrades before pounding once in a devastating shock wave. You deal @Damage[18d4[sonic]] damage in a @Template[cone|distance:60]. Enemies can attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|basic] save with a DC equal to your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. If you are adjacent to at least 1 ally, this deals @Damage[18d6[sonic]]{18d6}, if you are adjacent to at least 2 allies, this deals @Damage[18d8[sonic]]{18d8}.

(Affinity Ablaze) Winter's Roar: Rampagi.name: (Affinity Ablaze) Winter's Roar: Rampaging Glacier Charge
(Affinity Ablaze) Winter's Roar: Rampagi.description:
Frequency once per day

There are few bonds like those between fighters who have shared blows in an arena, and in so doing, come to understand each other. You focus on your emotional connection to one of the other tournament teams, and their power roars along it to you like a string set alight. You use the following ability, which you must have gained access to from the original team.

You emulate the inexorable movement of a glacier. You Stride up to your Speed and make a melee Strike. Regardless of whether your attack hits, the path of your Stride is filled by a 9th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.R5FHRv7VqyRnxg2t]{Wall of Ice}.

Prove Peace.name: 证实和平 Prove Peace
Prove Peace.description:
需求 你必须知晓产生该围城碎片的那次战斗，并且围城碎片被禁足@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]。

你触碰围城碎片，建立心灵链接，并且传达战斗已经结束的事实。

尝试一次@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识 Recall Knowledge}检定来回想那场导致围城碎片产生的战斗，并对抗围城碎片的意志DC。如果你成功，你证实战斗已经结束，围城碎片就会变成普通的石头。如果你大失败，过往的画面会压垮你的精神，你陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑 Confused}状态直到你的下一回合结束。

Administer.name: Administer
Administer.description:
You spend the day attending to administrative needs related to running Citadel Altaerein. The Administer activity can be used to undo poor public relations from the use of Deception or Intimidate to Organize Labor, but it is also used to maintain relations with groups you make contact with over the course of the Age of Ashes campaign.

Only one person can attempt to Administer per day (though others can Aid, as described in the Core Rulebook), and once the castle has been Administered, no one else can Administer until after the interval specified in the result. However, the GM might allow exceptions to this if, for instance, the group is about to go on an adventure and wants to make sure the citadel runs smoothly while they're gone.

If you perform downtime activities involving Citadel Altaerein when it's not successfully Administered, you take a -4 circumstance penalty to your checks.

Administering requires a successful @Check[society|dc:20] check (although for special actions later in the Adventure Path, this DC may change). You can pay a seneschal to attend to Citadel Altaerein's administrative needs. As long as the seneschal is paid, the weekly requirement to Administer is automatically a success (but never a critical success).

Critical Success You facilitate the prosperity of the citadel. The citadel functions smoothly for 1 month. In addition, during this time you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to all checks to Organize Labor.

Success Citadel Altaerein functions smoothly for 1 week.

Failure Citadel Altaerein is not Administered, but you can try again the next day.

Critical Failure Citadel Altaerein is not Administered. Botched relations and flared tempers among certain citizens in Breachill prevent you from attempting to Administer again for 1 week.

Loot the Vaults.name: Loot the Vaults
Loot the Vaults.description:
Requirement The PCs have reached the basement by Overcoming the Find the Cells Obstacle.

Overcome 2 successes: @Check[arcana|dc:33], @Check[perception|dc:35], @Check[thievery|dc:35]

In addition to the captives, the Scarlet Triad has stored numerous treasures in the manor's basement. The PCs take several minutes to unlock a vault and identify the best objects to steal. This Opportunity can be completed twice. The first time, the PCs recover a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.EKXRigmEZgqmFA62]{Nethysian Bulwark}, a broad crystal bowl inlaid with faience designs of ibises (worth 300 gp), and an onyx-and-marble statue of Nethys (worth 200 gp). In addition, the PCs also find a ledger detailing many Scarlet Triad transactions. With a successful @Check[guild-lore|dc:28] or a @Check[society|dc:35] check, a PC paging through the ledger determines that the Scarlet Triad has been dodging taxes, undercutting competition, and attempting to accumulate a lot of money very quickly-all in ways that quietly harm the Fleshmonger Federation, Aspis Consortium, and church of Abadar. Once for each guild, a PC can use the ledger when Influencing a Guild to reduce that organization's Support Points by an additional 2 points. The second time the PCs complete this Opportunity, they recover a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.K2rMmiBlzcysNuj6]{Belt of Regeneration}, as well as an alabaster-and-silver amphoriskos perfume bottle within which is bound the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.Actor.GyigGu36XLPV72nW]{Djinni} vizier Palqari the Wise. The Scarlet Triad trapped Palqari and offered him freedom in exchange for three wishes. Uri Zandivar already used two of these wishes to assist with the repair of the Orb of Gold Dragonkind, but then refrained from redeeming his last wish. Palqari is amenable to granting this last wish to the PCs if they help him escape; until then, he can't travel more than 20 feet from his amphoriskos, nor can he move it himself. This wish can be used to automatically rescue all of the slaves, but the PCs will still need to escape on their own. Although Palqari is eager to return to the Plane of Air, he could become a recurring ally later in the adventure at your discretion.

Critical Failure The PCs are noticed by a group of guards. At the end of every round of combat, Awareness increases by 1.

Seasonal Boon (Close Ties).name: 季节恩惠-亲密友人 Seasonal Boon (Close Ties)
Seasonal Boon (Close Ties).description:
频率 每季节一次

触发 小队中某人使柳岸镇一名NPC态度变为友善

效果 你的声望彰显，即便你不是尝试影响NPC的人。NPC会变为乐于帮助而非友善。使得一名NPC变为乐于帮助会从他们在柳岸镇的地点解锁额外的支援——你的GM对于此机制拥有更多信息。

Guild Investigation.name: 调查行会 Guild Investigation
Guild Investigation.description:
一名PC花费一整日时间来尝试一次DC30的技能检定，并以此来推进对行会的调查。

大成功 PC 们的调查结果令人信服，证实布里根是这些劣质武器背后的罪犯，此外调查还向PC们揭示出了他的店铺的所在位置。这些证据使得PC们在布里根的店铺中与其对峙时便让他认罪了，而非通过审问迫使他招供。

成功 调查表明布里根是这些劣质武器的幕后黑手，并且还向 PC 们揭示出了他的店铺位置。

失败 调查未能得出结论，但也没有打草惊蛇地惊动到布里根。

大失败 调查未能得出结论，但布里根知道 PC 们已经盯上他了。他抛下了自己的店铺并逃到了隐蔽锻铁厂向其他卓斯卡信徒寻求庇护。在此情况下，PC 们能够在区域 D2 遭遇到布里根——你可以在这场遭遇中使用缇娅（Thea）的数据来扮演布里根。

Holy Light.name: 灼热圣光 Holy Light
Holy Light.description:
Aspect celestial

Activate 2 command, Interact

Effect Your relic shines with holy light. This creates bright light in a @Template[emanation|distance:30] around the item. Evil creatures in the area are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}, and can't lower their frightened value below 1 as long as they remain in the light. Fiends in the area increase any weakness to holy they have by 5. You can Sustain this Activation for up to 1 minute.

Flight.name: Flight
Flight.description:
Frequency once per day

Unbound by the weight of flesh and bones, you become untouched by even the most basic of mortal experiences—gravity. You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed or 30 feet, whichever is greater, for 10 minutes. While flying, you might grow more ghostly in appearance, or you might leave some sort of temporary flickering trail in the air while you travel as you see fit.

Invoke Shrine Blessing.name: Invoke Shrine Blessing
Invoke Shrine Blessing.description:
Requirements You are holding an unblessed copper coin and are adjacent to one of Willowshore's shrines.

You offer prayers to a shrine and implore its associated deity to bless a copper coin. Place the copper coin before the shrine, then spend 10 minutes in prayer before the shrine. Attempt a @Check[religion|dc:15] or deity Lore check or a DC 17 skill check associated with the deity's teachings—two alternate skills are available for each shrine, as detailed in the Willowshore's Shrines. If you worship the deity in question, increase the result of your check by one degree of success.

Critical Success The deity blesses the copper coin but also imbues you with additional divine energy and insight. You heal @Damage[(1d8+8)[healing]] Hit Points and can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.izcxFQFwf3woCnFs]{Guidance} once in the next 24 hours as a divine spell. You treat all further critical successes at Invoking Shrine Blessing as regular successes instead.

Success The deity blesses the copper coin.

Failure You fail, and can't attempt to invoke a blessing at this specific shrine again for 24 hours.

Critical Failure You anger the deity. The copper coin vanishes, you can't attempt to invoke a blessing at this shrine again for 1 week, and you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 hour.

Soul Ward.name: Soul Ward
Soul Ward.description:
Frequency once

Trigger You would gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition, or you would be destroyed

Effect You regain @Damage[200[healing]] Hit Points, up to your maximum Hit Points. All resistances and temporary Hit Points granted to you by Geb immediately end.

Heat Haze.name: Heat Haze
Heat Haze.description:
Aspect fire

Your relic's heat keeps the air around you pleasantly warm. While you are holding or wearing the relic, it protects you from severe environmental cold. At 9th level, it also protects you from extreme cold, and at 17th level, it protects you from incredible cold. At 4th level, the relic also gains the following activation.

Activate 2 (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect Your relic erratically elevates the air temperature around you, creating heat shimmers that distort your appearance and grant you the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition for 1 minute. As the nature of this effect still leaves your location obvious, you can't use this concealment to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}.

Wind Barrier.name: 风之屏障 Wind Barrier
Wind Barrier.description:
性相 气赋礼

启动 1 专注

效果 产生一道隐形的空气屏障，可以偏转受到的远程攻击。直到你下回合开始前，你的AC在针对远程攻击时获得+2环境加值。达到13级时，该加值提升为+3。

Elements of Creation.name: Elements of Creation
Elements of Creation.description:
Aspect forge

Prerequisites creative spark gift

When you activate creative spark, you can choose to summon an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core-2.Actor.Q6oMLXjmGqF6dxzp]{Air Wisp}, a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core-2.Actor.PV8ex8ivTfD7bzEP]{Water Wisp}, and an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core-2.Actor.5YmEdbkqk1IYWL7B]{Earth Wisp} in unoccupied squares next to you, in addition to the fire wisp. Unlike a typical earth wisp, the summoned earth wisp takes the form of a small iron creature resembling an anvil crossed with a horned beetle. Like the fire wisp, these additional wisps don't act in combat but can assist you while you Craft items. While all four wisps are assisting you, the bonus you gain from creative spark is doubled, and your outcome for Crafting checks related to blacksmithing is one degree of success better than your roll. In addition, being assisted by all four wisps replaces the need for any equipment other than blacksmithing tools when crafting metal items. The wisps last for up to 10 minutes or until you Dismiss them all together as an action. If you extend the duration of the fire wisp, it also extends the duration for the other wisps.

Undying Flesh.name: Undying Flesh
Undying Flesh.description: You're a fearsome and vengeful spirit, and certain physical weapons seem to have little effect on you. Choose bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing; you gain resistance 10 to that damage type. Whether your resistance to that damage manifests in the form of a weapon appearing to pass harmlessly through your body or by appearing to leave grievous wounds that you ignore is left to you to decide, but once the decision is made, you can't change it.

Prepare the Processional.name: Prepare the Processional
Prepare the Processional.description:
You spend four days incorporating the following elements into your processional (up to four). Attempt one skill check from the skills listed for each element you choose to incorporate into your processional. The results of these checks determine how many Preparation Points you earn.

Themes: You come up with one theme essential to the processional and determine how to infuse it into every aspect of the celebration. Attempt one of the following skill checks: Lore (if you draw upon knowledge of a thematic topic), Religion (if the theme involves religious inspiration or relies heavily on undead in some way), or Society (if you focus on Geb's history, politics, and zeitgeist).

Exhibits: You work to create or arrange the physical elements of the processional's display, such as statues or icons carried aloft, decorated wagons, extravagant puppetry, trained animals, or the like. Attempt one of the following skill checks: Athletics (if you provide manual labor), Crafting (if you create puppets, chisel statues, or decorate vehicles), or Nature (if you train animals to take part in the processional).

Pageantry: You create the costumes and accessories the participants carry or wear during the processional. Attempt one of the following skill checks: Crafting (if you design the outfits or items to be carried), Deception (if you intend the outfits to be recognizable representations of specific individuals in the form of a disguise), or Performance (if you choreograph dances or compose original music).

Revelers: You recruit a large number of locals to take part in your processional. Attempt one of the following skill checks: Diplomacy (to convince people to join your processional), Intimidation (to threaten them with dire consequences if they don't take part), or Performance (to inspire them to share in your artistic vision).

Critical Success You gain 2 Preparation Points for the party.

Success You gain 1 Preparation Point for the party.

Critical Failure You lose 1 Preparation Point for the party.
Prepare the Processional.gmnote:
Themes: @Check[religion,society|dc:28|showDC:gm] - Note that a lore skill can be used at your discretion

Exhibits: @Check[athletics,crafting,nature|dc:28]

Pageantry: @Check[crafting,deception,performance|dc:28]

Revelers: @Check[diplomacy,intimidation,performance|dc:28]

Perform the Processional Results

Preparation Points DC XP Earned
8 or less 33 10 XP
9-13 30 20 XP
14-18 28 40 XP
19-23 26 60 XP
24 or more 23 80 XP

Curiosity.name: Curiosity
Curiosity.description:
A desire for knowledge can be a powerful motivation. This focus also commonly manifests in young or otherwise innocent spirits, as they're bound mainly by a desire to see the world a little longer. You reach out to touch an adjacent living target, and for a moment, your hand becomes incorporeal as it passes through their body. The target must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save, after which they're immune to this power.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success You perceive vague surface thoughts from the target and find out whether its Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Failure As success, but you can probe into the target's mind and attempt to uncover the answer to a question you telepathically pose to them. The target can attempt a @Check[deception|against:class-spell] check against your spirit power's DC; if the target succeeds, you don't learn the answer, and on a critical success, the target gives you a false answer you believe is truthful.

Critical Failure As failure, but once you resolve the telepathic question and its answer, the target loses all memory of this event.

Study.name: 学习 Study
Study.description:
需求 你是入门生（initiate）、助研生（attendant）或者上级生（conversant）。

你把所有的精力都投入对应分支的到学习中去。选择你的主要或副分支，尝试用分支相关技能之一进行一次技能检定，DC为基于当前分支的等级的标准DC。

大成功 难以置信的结果！你每次考试都取得好成绩，引起了所有老师的关注。增加你选择的分支等级2

成功 你很好地完成了你的学业。增加你选择的分支等级1

失败 你需要更努力一点并且再试一次。你的分支等级没有变化

大失败 你犯了一个大错因此你需要补课。当你下次有机会再次尝试此项休整期行动时，你必须跳过这次行动才能赶上你的同学们。

Seasonal Boon (Willowshore Urchin).name: 季节恩惠-柳岸镇流浪儿 Seasonal Boon (Willowshore Urchin)
Seasonal Boon (Willowshore Urchin).description:
频率 每个季度一次

触发 你（或一名相邻的PC）将要掷骰恢复检定

效果 你不进行掷骰恢复检定而是自动取得大成功，因为你有健硕的体格，顽强的态度，或只是老好运继续让你存活下来就跟儿时一样。如果你与一名将要掷骰恢复检定的PC相邻，你可以改为用此恩惠来给予其本效果。

Breaking the Chains.name: Breaking the Chains
Breaking the Chains.description:
Requirements The PCs have overcome the other three Obstacles for this phase.

Overcome 2 successes; @Check[athletics|dc:37], @Check[thievery|dc:33]

The captives are sealed behind bars and chained to the walls. The PCs undo these bindings as quietly as possible. Once the PCs defeat this Obstacle, they have freed Exavisu and one of her assistants and can begin Phase 4: Extraction. See the That's Not Everyone Complication.

Deduce Traditions.name: 推测传统 Deduce Traditions
Deduce Traditions.description:
通过解读摄政者的性格，利用你对矮人传统的了解，并由此作出合理的推论，你能够推测出该名矮人摄政者的行会最看重的是什么技巧——并由此推断出何种技能最有可能得到这名摄政者的青睐。推测传统需要成功通过@Check[perception|dc:30]检定或者成功通过@Check[society|dc:25]检定才能得到精准的结果。

大成功 你了解到该行会的一项偏好技能，并且得知该名摄政者的疑虑数值。

成功 你了解到该行会的一项偏好技能。

失败 你未能了解到该行会偏好技能。

大失败 你误认为一项错误的技能是该行会偏好技能。

Secure Disguises.name: 获取伪装 Secure Disguises
Secure Disguises.description:
Overcome @Check[crafting|dc:35], @Check[deception|dc:33], @Check[performance|dc:35], @Check[society|dc:37]

The PC tries to find disguises of a certain type (guards, for example, or socialites).

Success The PC finds or creates useful disguises that grant 1 Edge Point that the PCs can use for maintaining a cover identity.

Failure The PC finds no disguises.

Steal Keys.name: Steal Keys
Steal Keys.description:
Requirement PCs noticed the keys while Breaking and Entering.

Overcome @Check[thievery|dc:35]

The PC steals a ring of keys that can unlock many of the manor's doors.

Success The PCs gain 1 Edge Point usable for opening locks.

Cram.name: 突击应考 Cram
Cram.description:
需求 你是入门生（initiate）、助研生（attendant）或者上级生（conversant），并且你的主分支或副分支等级比限制低2级以上。

你意识到自己在学习上落后了，因此需要花更多的时间进行填鸭式学习。你进行两次学习行动，每次都必须选择满足要求的分支。然而，熬夜学习是有代价的。直到你有机会进行下一次学习行动之前，你会因为将所有时间用来突击学习而变得特别累。在你冒险中的每一天开始前，你必须通过@Check[flat|dc:8]检定，否则@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]一天。

Spite.name: Spite
Spite.description:
Even if a person was kind in life, the dead have many reasons to spite the living, and the violent urges of the departed are why ghosts are so often feared. This focus isn't just fueled by hate; righteous fury can empower these abilities, though even the most virtuous of feelings can become twisted over time. Spite takes the form of curses, punishing the target with various bodily maladies. Point to a target you can see within 30 feet. The target must then attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] saving throw, after which they're immune to this power.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target's skin itches uncontrollably. If the target doesn't spend an action to scratch at the itch, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of its next turn. This effect lasts for 1 minute.

Failure The target's skin breaks out in painful lesions and unsightly sores. The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} for 24 hours.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for the duration.

Seek the Hidden Forge.name: Seek the Hidden Forge
Seek the Hidden Forge.description:
Requirements At least one Hidden Forge clue.

By spending a day examining Hidden Forge clues, consulting with locals, studying maps of Kovlar, and otherwise investigating the mystery, a PC attempts to determine the location of the secret shrine to Droskar in the dwarven city. A character can attempt to interpret these clues with a Perception, Society, or Survival check-the DC remains 36 regardless of the check used to interpret the clues. This DC is reduced by 2 for each Hidden Forge clue possessed beyond the first. Thus, if the character has access to two Hidden Forge Clues, the DC is reduced to 34, up to a maximum reduction to DC 22 if a character has 8 Hidden Forge Clues.

Critical Success The PC pinpoints the entrance to the Hidden Forge.

Success The PC makes significant progress toward determining the Hidden Forge's location, and gains a +4 circumstance bonus on their next check to Seek the Hidden Forge.

Failure The PC fails to determine anything informative from the clues.

Critical Failure As failure, but the Droskar cultists catch wind of the investigation and are able to prepare their defenses.

Seek the Animals.name: Seek the Animals
Seek the Animals.description:
You help the elven hunters look for signs of animals. Attempt a @Check[nature|dc:17] check or @Check[perception|dc:17].

Critical Success You make an impressive and potentially dangerous find, such as a large pack of particularly healthy (and thus cranky) red river boars or a large waterbuck with razor-sharp horns. You also find signs of animals that are safer to hunt than your impressive and delicious find.

Success You discover signs of animals that are safe to hunt.

Failure Your efforts have scared away the best game, and the hunting party must set their sights on river turtles and bats.

Critical Failure Your efforts have scared away too many animals, leaving the hunting party with a sparse amount of game to catch. The party loses 2 IP.

Underground Bounty.name: Underground Bounty
Underground Bounty.description:
Aspect earth

Your relic produces metals and stones to empower your weapons. Each day during your daily preparations, your relic conjures a magical shard of silver, cold iron, gold, or a non-precious stone or metal material of your choice (such as bronze or granite). If your relic is a weapon, it immediately absorbs the shard, causing it to gain a magical sheen of that metal or stone until your next daily preparations. If your relic is not a weapon, the shard is not immediately used, and you can touch it to a stone or metal weapon using an Interact action to give it a magical sheen of that metal or stone for 10 minutes. While coated in the magical sheen, the weapon interacts with weaknesses, resistances, and the like as if it were made of the stone or metal from the shard rather than its own. The sheen and the shard are obviously magical in nature, and if you don't use the shard, it disappears when you make your next daily preparations. At 17th level, add adamantine and dawnsilver to the available options.

Apothecary's Garden.name: Apothecary's Garden
Apothecary's Garden.description:
Aspect plant

Your relic grows potent natural medicines. Each night, two medicinal herbs (or other plants) grow from your relic and can be harmlessly harvested during your next daily preparations. A living creature that consumes an herb with an Interact action regains @Damage[1d8[healing]] Hit Points for every 2 relic levels (minimum 1d8). At 9th level, the relic grows three herbs each night, and at 17th level, the relic grows four herbs each night. Herbs wither away 1 day after being harvested.

Exhale Poison.name: 呼吐毒素 Exhale Poison
Exhale Poison.description:
Frequency once per hour

Requirements You were within the area of an inhaled poison within the last minute; @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.8PMxl8o5YXET58Pn]{Iron Lung}

You sharply exhale the poison that previously surrounded you in a @Template[cone|distance:15]. Creatures in the area are affected by the poison; the poison's DC and effects are unchanged.

Repair Crumbled Walls.name: Repair Crumbled Walls
Repair Crumbled Walls.description:
Requirements Crafting (expert), Specialty Crafting (stonemasonry), or hired stonemason; organized workers

You work to repair a collapsed wall in either the training hall (area A8), the Court of the Nail (area A13), or the records room (area A17). Each room's repair takes 8 days of work and a @Check[crafting|dc:20] check.

Fire the Cannons! (3-4).name: Fire the Cannons! (3-4)
Fire the Cannons! (3-4).description:
You help the Unsinkable's crew to fire the ship's cannons at the manifestation of Qxal. The cannons can fire either cannonballs or harpoons at a range of 100 feet. Attempt an [[/r {1d20+17} #Attack roll]]{attack roll with a +17 bonus} against the manifestation.

Critical Success As a success, but the manifestation takes double damage. If hit by a harpoon, the manifestation is pulled 30 feet toward the Unsinkable.

Success The manifestation takes @Damage[(2d8+9)[bludgeoning]] damage if hit by a cannonball or takes @Damage[(1d8+4)[piercing]] damage and is pulled 15 feet toward the Unsinkable if hit by a harpoon.

Failure The attack deals no damage.

Critical Failure The attack deals no damage and the cannon can't be fired again on the next round.

Pander to the Crowd.name: Pander to the Crowd
Pander to the Crowd.description:
Requirement This is your first action in a gladiatorial match, or you've damaged or visibly impeded a foe while fighting a gladiatorial match.

With a mocking gesture, a triumphant flourish, or a bold challenge, you inspire the crowd to cheer you on. Attempt an Acrobatics, Athletics, Intimidation, or Performance check, with a DC typically set by the encounter's level. Crowds grow bored with repetition though; and attempting to Pander to the Crowd using the same skill that was used the last time someone used this action imposes a -2 circumstance penalty on the check. If you critically succeeded at an attack roll this turn, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Pander to the Crowd attempt.

Critical Success The crowd goes wild! You can either give yourself a +3 status bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, saving throws, and skill checks until the end of your next turn, or give yourself and all your allies a +2 status bonus to the same rolls until the end of your next turn.

Success You appeal to the crowd. As critical success, but the bonus is +2 just for you, or +1 for you and your allies.

Failure You don't make an impression.

Critical Failure Your pandering is laughable, and the crowd begins to favor your opponents. The next creature hostile to you that attempts to Pander to the Crowd gains a +4 circumstance bonus to the check.

Blazing Soul.name: Blazing Soul
Blazing Soul.description:
Aspect fire

Fire magic suffuses your body and soul, protecting you from lesser flames and allowing you to kindle even the smallest sparks into powerful infernos. You gain fire resistance 10. The first time each hour you are targeted by a fire effect that would deal damage, you regain @Damage[1d8[healing]] Hit Points per counteract rank of the effect, in addition to taking the damage.

Activate r (concentrate)

Trigger A creature within 60 feet is critically hit by or critically fails a save against a fire effect and is not reduced to 0 Hit Points

Effect Flames roar forth from the triggering creature, dealing @Damage[6d6[fire]] damage to all creatures in a @Template[burst|distance:15] centered on it, including that creature (@Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic]). You aren't affected by the activation, though your allies are. If this damage reduces the triggering creature to 0 Hit Points, it's reduced to a fine ash, though its gear remains. You can't use this activation again for [[/r 1d4 #Recharge Blazing Soul]] rounds.

Bottomless Reservoir.name: Bottomless Reservoir
Bottomless Reservoir.description:
Aspect water

Activate 1 (manipulate)

Effect Your relic can absorb and release water, storing it in an endless reservoir. You either touch your relic to an adjacent body of water and absorb 1 gallon of it into the reservoir, or you release 1 gallon of a liquid from the reservoir. You can add another action to the activation to absorb water from a touched creature made entirely of water, like a water elemental. If you do, it takes @Damage[1d6] damage per relic level (@Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|basic] save).

Activate r (manipulate)

Trigger You are targeted by an acid or water effect

Effect Your relic attempts to counteract the effect, expending 1 gallon of stored liquid. At the GM's discretion, you can use this ability on effects made of other liquids, such as blood.

Seasonal Boon (Southbank Traditionalist).name: 季节恩惠-南岸传统派 Seasonal Boon (Southbank Traditionalist)
Seasonal Boon (Southbank Traditionalist).description:
频率 每个季度一次

触发 小队的南岸声望增加

效果 额外提高小队的南岸声望2点（你的GM有着有关柳岸镇声望的额外信息）。

Creative Spark.name: Creative Spark
Creative Spark.description:
Aspect forge

Activate 2 command, Interact

Frequency once per day

Effect You strike the relic against a piece of flint and summon a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core-2.Actor.micllXbcz1eBcAoz]{Fire Wisp} to assist you, which appears in an unoccupied square next to you. The fire wisp doesn't act in combat, but it can assist you while you Craft items. You gain a +1 bonus to Crafting checks involving blacksmithing and general metalworking, increasing to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 17th level. Once per day, when you roll a critical failure on a Crafting check related to blacksmithing, you get a failure instead. The wisp replaces the need for a forge while blacksmithing, but you still require other equipment and tools. The wisp remains for up to 10 minutes or until you Dismiss it. You can extend this duration by an additional 10 minutes if you feed the wisp one light Bulk worth of charcoal or firewood, or one pint of oil.

Upgrade Defenses.name: Upgrade Defenses
Upgrade Defenses.description:
