Requirements Crafting (master), Specialty Crafting (stonemasonry), or hired stonemason; organized specialists

You bolster Citadel Altaerein's walls with metal braces, skillful engineering, and other supports. This upgrade takes 40 days of work and a @Check[crafting|dc:25] check.

Form of Fury.name: Form of Fury
Form of Fury.description:
Aspect beast

Prerequisites The relic is a worn item.

Activate 2 (concentrate)

Frequency twice per day

Effect Calling upon the bestial nature within, you change shape into that of an animal. The relic casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wp09USMB3GIW1qbp]{Animal Form} on you, transforming you into the same type of animal every time, chosen when the gift is gained; the spell rank is half the item's level, rounded down.

Rebuild Battlements.name: Rebuild Battlements
Rebuild Battlements.description:
Requirements Crafting (expert), Specialty Crafting (stonemasonry), or hired stonemason; organized workers

You rebuild and restore the collapsed battlements along the northern section of the central tower. This task takes 28 days of work and a @Check[crafting|dc:20] check.

Death Gaze.name: Death Gaze
Death Gaze.description:
Aspect death

Activate 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Effect Your stare causes a creature's flesh to rot and wither away. Target a creature you can see within 30 feet. Your stare deals @Damage[1d6[void]] damage to the creature for every 2 levels the relic has (minimum 1d6; @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|basic] save). An undead creature or other creature with void healing targeted this way is instead healed @Damage[1d6[healing]] HP per level of the relic and is temporarily immune to this effect for 10 minutes.

Linguistic Nexus.name: 语言链接 Linguistic Nexus
Linguistic Nexus.description:
性相 心智

你的圣物赋予你强大的神经可塑性，结果是你可以更容易地学习语言。圣物每有2个等级，你就可以学习1种额外语言（至少1种）。你只需要花费1周的修整期就能通过圣物重训一种语言。

Smuggled.name: Smuggled
Smuggled.description:
Overcome @Check[stealth|dc:33]

The PCs hide themselves inside carts, wine barrels, or other large containers that are bound for the estate. This deposits them inside the walls but a distance from the manor.

Special This process leaves participating PCs disheveled, imposing a -1 circumstance penalty to checks tied to appearing well groomed or professional.

Duty.name: Duty
Duty.description:
Stoic resolve or plain stubbornness form the core of this focus. While the dead can't demand their flesh persist beyond their time, they can still impose some of their iron will on other people. This focus expresses itself as an ability to whisper in the ears of the living. You whisper to a target within 30 feet that you can see. The target must then attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] saving throw, after which they're immune to this power.

Critical Success The target hears your whispered words but isn't otherwise affected.

Success The target is unnerved by your whispered words and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target hears your whispered words and must obey your suggested course of action for 1 minute, until it has completed the task, or until the task becomes self-destructive or has other obvious negative effects. Your suggested course of action must be phrased in such a way as to seem like a logical course of action to the target.

Critical Failure As failure, but the duration is 1 hour.

Flowing Footsteps.name: Flowing Footsteps
Flowing Footsteps.description:
Aspect water

Your relic ensures no water impedes your movement. You gain the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Seaah9amXg70RKw2]{Water Walk} spell, and the ability to breathe water. You also gain a swim Speed equal to your Speed or 15 feet, whichever is higher.

Word of Faith.name: 信仰真言 Word of Faith
Word of Faith.description:
性相 天族

启动 2 命令，交互

频率 每小时一次

效果 通过用手触碰你自己或你的盟友，你可以治愈他们的伤口并抚慰他们的精神。圣物每级都能让目标恢复@Damage[1d8[healing]]HP，并且能让目标的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]状态值-1。

Influence Guild.name: Influence Guild
Influence Guild.description:
You dedicate a day to befriending members of a particular guild, assisting the organization, and convincing the guild members not to support the Scarlet Triad. Attempt a DC 34 skill check tied to one of the organization's favored skills.

Critical Success Reduce that organization's Support Points by 3.

Success Reduce that organization's Support Points by 1.

Critical Failure Increase that organization's Support Points by 1.

Delusion.name: Delusion
Delusion.description:
You weave illusions to fool mortal senses. However, the metaphysical distance between the spirit world and that of the living distorts how these figments appear to living viewers. To undead, and to creatures with illusion-piercing abilities such as truesight, the images appear as you intend for them to. To other observers, these illusions always take on a macabre tone. Blood, bone, and shadow replace more mundane materials in the composition. Speech is warped to resemble either shrill screams or low-pitched growls and is generally unintelligible. You gain a +2 status bonus to Deception checks.

Once per day, you can cast one of the following spells as a 5th-rank innate occult spell: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{Illusory Creature}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2oH5IufzdESuYxat]{Illusory Object}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Ucf8eynbZMfUucjE]{Illusory Scene}.

Grim Specter.name: Grim Specter
Grim Specter.description:
Aspect death

Activate 2 (concentrate, polymorph, void)

Frequency once per day

Effect You can call upon the terrifying powers that fuel your relic to transform yourself into a specter of death. You become incorporeal, having no physical body. You are immune to effects that require a physical body, including precision damage as well as exposure to most diseases and poisons. You also have resistance to all damage equal to half the relic's level; force damage, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]{Ghost Touch} attacks, spirit damage, void damage, and vitality damage ignore this resistance, and the resistance doubles against non-magical damage.

You can move through solid objects. When inside an object, you can't perceive, attack, or Interact with anything outside it, and you're always @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} on turns you start in an object. Corporeal creatures can pass through you but can't end their movement in your space. You can't attempt Strength-based checks against corporeal creatures or objects, unless those objects have the ghost touch property rune. Likewise, corporeal creatures can't attempt Strength-based checks against you.

You can Sustain the activation for up to 1 minute.

Obsession.name: Obsession
Obsession.description:
This spirit power represents an extreme fixation on a particular object. While this is most often a result of insatiable greed, this could also represent fondness for a cherished heirloom or attachment to a defining piece of art that a person created. This focus is appropriate for a character particularly attached to their wealth or to a particular piece of gear. It expresses itself as an ability to telekinetically control small objects. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.60sgbuMWN0268dB7]{Telekinetic Projectile} at will as a 5th-rank innate occult cantrip.

Once per day, you can cast one of the following spells as a 5th-rank innate occult spell: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WqPhJNzLa8vSjrH6]{Animated Assault}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.UirEIHILQgip87qv]{Charitable Urge}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tpLTLbJUrYcMWGld]{Telekinetic Haul}.

Healing Wave.name: Healing Wave
Healing Wave.description:
Aspect life

Activate 2 (concentrate)

Frequency once per hour

Effect You release a wave of vitality energy in a @Template[cone|distance:15]. You and each living target in the area regain @Damage[1d4[healing]] HP per level of the relic.

Build Connections.name: Build Connections
Build Connections.description:
You dedicate a day to making friends in high places, typically by inviting yourself to parties, performing small favors to be repaid later, and generally projecting an aura of confidence and capability. Attempt a @Check[crafting|dc:36], @Check[diplomacy|dc:36], @Check[performance|dc:36], or appropriate Lore check. The result determines the impact of your efforts. If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.iCv8KTZ5PcF4GqeV]{Leverage Connections} skill feat and roll a success, you get a critical success instead.

Critical Success For 1 month, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your skill checks to pursue the downtime activities listed here. You also earn a single favor that you can call in when you or an ally you're working with attempts a skill check for one of these downtime actions. That creature can roll twice and use the better result, after which the favor is considered repaid; calling in the favor is a fortune effect.

Success For 1 week, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your skill checks for the downtime activities listed here.

Critical Failure A faux pas embarrasses you, and rumors recount the incident widely. For 3 days, you take a -1 circumstance penalty to skill checks for the downtime activities listed here.

Obscure.name: 融入黑暗 Obscure
Obscure.description:
性相 阴影

你的圣物吸收周围光线，用阴影将你包裹，使你隐藏在黑暗中。只要你位于阴影下的昏暗环境中，你就能尝试1次隐蔽检定来@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]，即使你并没有对目标生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]，例如一个具有黑暗视觉的生物。

Dispel a Disguise.name: Dispel a Disguise
Dispel a Disguise.description:
Requirement When Blending In or using a Cunning Disguise, a PC has noticed something is off about a guest.

Overcome @Check[arcana|dc:35], @Check[occultism|dc:33], @Check[perception|dc:37]

The PC is sure there's more to Baroness Epminia Fahlspar than meets the eye. They're right-she's Reloon, a rakshasa in disguise!

Critical Success The PC sees through the disguise and identifies a way to unveil the rakshasa without magic. Rakshasas are not unwelcome here, but the sudden reveal of Reloon's natural form and her dismayed outburst draws the attention of many partyers. Reduce Awareness by 2 (minimum 0).

Success The PC senses the magical disguise. To overcome this Opportunity, a PC must either magically counteract the disguise or succeed at a @Check[deception|dc:40] or @Check[intimidation|dc:40] check to cause the baroness's concentration to waver, briefly disrupting her disguise. This reveals her, as described under critical success.

Failure The PC sees no evidence of a disguise.

Critical Failure The PC sees no evidence of a disguise, and their scrutiny invites a loud dressing down by the baroness.

Assessing Tatzlford's Defenses.name: 评估泰兹尔滩的防御 Assessing Tatzlford's Defenses
Assessing Tatzlford's Defenses.description:
队伍花了一个小时浏览泰兹尔滩，评估该镇的防御措施还有哪些改进的地方。他们会直接得出设置路障会有作用的结论，使他们可以进行下文提到的设置路障动作。尝试进行一次@Check[defense|dc:23|roller:party]或@Check[warfare|dc:27|roller:party]王国技能检定来确定额外进行的防御措施改进，可以进行以下动作：@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.adventure-specific-actions.Item.pWxRtCeAw4XnyzoM]、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.adventure-specific-actions.Item.tay92zbn04IR40qv]、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.adventure-specific-actions.Item.sWTvJahHpdz4CC6E]或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.adventure-specific-actions.Item.z1noqZiavhnqQL50]。如果玩家自己提出了上述其中之一想法（或者根据你的判断还有其他类似想法），无论检定结果如何他们都可以进行对应动作。

大成功 队伍获得全部四次额外防御动作。

成功 队伍获得两次额外防御动作，随机确定动作种类。

失败 队伍获得一次额外防御动作，随机确定动作种类。

大失败 PC只意识到可以进行设置路障防御动作。

Incandescent Sight.name: Incandescent Sight
Incandescent Sight.description:
Aspect fire

Activate 2 (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect Your eyes become attuned to heat signatures as your vision extends into the infrared, granting you a heatsight precise sense for 1 minute. Your heatsight can see temperature gradients out to a range of 30 feet, allowing you to detect living creatures and warm objects even in the dark. Warm objects block your heatsight even if they are transparent, such as hot water.

Inextinguishable.name: Inextinguishable
Inextinguishable.description:
Aspect life

Your connection to life force makes you more difficult to snuff out than others. You die from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition at dying 5, rather than dying 4. If you roll a success on a save against a death or void effect, you get a critical success instead.

Clear Courtyard.name: Clear Courtyard
Clear Courtyard.description:
Requirements Crafting (trained) or hired stonemason; organized workers

You work to repair the collapsed northern wall, drain and fill in the flooded sunken area, and clear out weeds. This activity requires 6 days of work and a @Check[crafting|dc:15] check.

Diminish Shadow.name: 消散暗影 Diminish Shadow
Diminish Shadow.description: 你使用 暗星 的魔法削弱附近暗影的力量。暗影石像怪的抗力降低 2，直到你下回合开始时。此外，暗影石像怪必须尝试 @Check[fortitude|dc:17] 豁免。失败时，暗影石像怪必须立刻停止飞行并降落于其下方最近的开放空间。你每回合只能使用一次消散暗影。

Jet Propulsion.name: Jet Propulsion
Jet Propulsion.description:
Aspect fire

Activate 1 (concentrate)

Frequency once per hour

Effect Flames from your relic channel through your body, erupting from your feet, hands, or other limbs with enough force to blast you across the ground and propel you through the air. For 1 minute, you gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed and gain a fly Speed equal to your new Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater. You must end your turn on solid ground, or you fall.

Mesmerizing Performance.name: Mesmerizing Performance
Mesmerizing Performance.description:
需求 动物伙伴的前个动作是@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EEDElIyin4z60PXx]{表演 Perform}检定获得成功。动物伙伴保持它的表演，使30尺内目睹其成功表演的一个目标着迷。该目标必须尝试意志豁免。

成功 目标不受影响，并临时免疫1小时。

失败 目标因动物伙伴的下一个动作而承受@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{迷魂 Fascinated}状态，然后临时免疫1小时。

大失败 目标因动物伙伴而承受迷魂状态，持续1轮，在迷魂期间目标无法使用反应。

Seasonal Boon (Northridge Scholar).name: 季节恩惠-北岭学者 Seasonal Boon (Northridge Scholar)
Seasonal Boon (Northridge Scholar).description:
频率 每个季节一次

触发 小队的北岭声望增加

效果 额外提高小队的北岭声望2点（你的GM有着有关柳岸镇声望的额外信息）。

Divine Retribution.name: 神圣复仇 Divine Retribution
Divine Retribution.description:
性相 天族

先决条件 圣物是一件武器

启动 2 命令

效果 利用神之怒火，你选择一个在上一轮中对你或你的盟友造成伤害的目标，然后将充满圣物的神圣怒火倾泻到敌人身上。对那个敌人进行一次打击，如果命中则增加一个伤害骰。如果目标为邪恶阵营，它被命中的同时陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭 Enfeebled 1}，造成重击则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭 Enfeebled 2}，直到你的下个回合开始。

Reactive Scorch.name: Reactive Scorch
Reactive Scorch.description:
Trigger A creature Strikes you

Effect The creature takes @Damage[2d6[fire]] damage (@Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] save).

Life Everlasting.name: Life Everlasting
Life Everlasting.description:
Aspect life

Activate 2 (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect Massive amounts of vitality energy surge forth. For 1 minute, you emit vitality energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] centered on you. At the end of your turn, you (if you are living) and allied living creatures in the emanation regain @Damage[10[healing]] Hit Points. If you or an allied creature would die due to an increased @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} value, you can Dismiss the activation as a free action to prevent the death; if you do, their dying value doesn't increase.

Living Death.name: Living Death
Living Death.description:
Aspect death

You stand on the threshold between the living and the dead. If you attempt a saving throw against an effect that would deal void damage to you, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm}, your outcome is one degree of success better than what you rolled. If you roll a critical success and the effect is capable of healing undead, you regain Hit Points equal to half the spell's full damage. Any vitality spell or effect that would heal you has only half the normal effect. All these effects apply only if you are a living creature.

Promote the Circus.name: Promote the Circus
Promote the Circus.description:
You spend 2 consecutive days in town generating Anticipation for your next circus show. Attempt a @Check[society] check. The DC of this check is equal to the DC appropriate for the group's party level. One other PC can spend 2 downtime days to Aid you, providing a +2 circumstance bonus to your Society check if they succeed at a @Check[society|dc:20] check.

Critical Success You generate Anticipation equal to twice the sum of your level plus your Charisma modifier (minimum 2).

Success You generate Anticipation equal to your level plus your Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

Failure You generate 1 Anticipation.

Critical Failure You generate no Anticipation.

Clean.name: Clean
Clean.description: You spend the day cleaning-hauling out broken furniture, disposing of detritus, and making rooms clear enough to begin repairs. Citadel Altaerein requires 8 days of cleaning before any other basic repair activities can begin. Cleaning does not require a Crafting check, nor does it cost gold.

Navigate Steamgrotto.name: 穿越蒸汽岩地 Navigate Steamgrotto
Navigate Steamgrotto.description:
你耗费时间观察蒸汽岩地的间歇泉爆发的规律，然后为了避免陷入危险而尽可能规划你在该地区内的移动路线。你能够尝试自然、察觉，或生存技能来尝试穿越蒸汽岩地，这需要成功投掷DC35的检定，但使用察觉无法让你更加深入地认知到这些危险的本质，因此察觉检定会受到-4环境减值。

大成功 你避开了危险，且跟随专家的人在检定时从该行动中获得加值为正常的两倍。

成功 你避开了危险。

失败 在通过部分间歇泉的时候你靠得太近，且穿过的时机太差。你承受@Damage[10d6[fire]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:36|basic]豁免）。

大失败 你严重地误判了自己的行进路线，不慎被间歇泉直接喷中。你承受@Damage[20d6[fire]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:36|basic]豁免）。

Raise Ramparts.name: 构筑壁垒 Raise Ramparts
Raise Ramparts.description:
性相 土

启动 2 命令，交互

频率 每日一次

效果 圣物重塑了你周围的土地。你施展5环级@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kOa055FIrO9Smnya]。

Convince Mengkare.name: Convince Mengkare
Convince Mengkare.description:
You spend several minutes debating with the gold dragon Mengkare and have presented a piece of information that could potentially raise his Doubt score and cause him to reconsider his plans to sacrifice the citizens of Promise. Select one of the key skills associated with the argument you made, and attempt a check with that skill-the required DC depends on the skill used, as indicated in the Arguments against Glory section.

Critical Success You increase Mengkare's Doubt by 2.

Success You increase Mengkare's Doubt by 1.

Failure You fail to increase Mengkare's Doubt.

Critical Failure You undermine your argument. Reduce Mengkare's Doubt by 1.

Deadly Traps.name: Deadly Traps
Deadly Traps.description:
Overcome 2 successes; @Check[arcana|dc:34] or @Check[thievery|dc:34]

The PCs suppress or disable dangerous traps set to kill would-be thieves and make an explosive ruckus.

Special If a PC fails a check to overcome this scene, they trigger a trap that deals @Damage[16d6[untyped]] damage to that PC (@Check[reflex|dc:36|basic]). If the PC critically fails, it deals this damage to all PCs in the scene.

Monsoon Curtain.name: Monsoon Curtain
Monsoon Curtain.description:
Aspect water

Activate 3 (attack, concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You call down a curtain of violent rain in a location within 120 feet. The wall is 5 feet thick, 30 feet long, up to 30 feet high, and lasts for 1 minute. The wall stands vertically, but you can shape its path. The wall has the following effects.

  • If a fire effect crosses through the wall, it either uses the outcome one degree of success worse than the result of its attack roll or its targets use the outcome one degree of success better than the result of their saving throw, as appropriate.
  • Creatures with a weakness to water that cross the wall or start their turn in the wall take damage equal to their weakness.
  • The wall imposes a –2 status penalty to Perception checks to sense creatures or objects on the other side.

Distract Guards.name: Distract Guards
Distract Guards.description:
You attempt to distract a specific group of guards away from their patrol route or their post. You can do so by attempting a @Check[deception|dc:41] check, or by using a spell effect, in which case you attempt a @Check[arcana|dc:41], @Check[nature|dc:41], @Check[occultism|dc:41], or @Check[religion|dc:41] check (as appropriate) to determine success. Each attempt to Distract Guards takes a minute to play out-from the initial distraction to the guard's reaction.

Critical Success You significantly distract the guards away from their patrol area or post to an area in the citadel of your choice. The guards return to their original post after 1 hour has passed.

Success You distract the guards away from their patrol area or post to an area in the citadel of your choice. The guards return to their original post after 20 minutes have passed.

Failure You fail to distract the guards. Any attempt made in the next 10 minutes to distract the same guards takes a -2 penalty to the check.

Critical Failure As failure above, but the guards realize you're trying to distract them and escort you out of the building. If this is your third critical failure against that particular group of guards, the guard instead places you under arrest.

Rotate the Wheel.name: 旋转轮盘 Rotate the Wheel
Rotate the Wheel.description:
该角色花费时间旋转轮盘。这是一项耗费体力的工作，在本轮结束时，PC必须进行@Check[fortitude|dc:25]豁免。此豁免DC会随着旋转轮盘的次数而增加。旋转七圈后，这个房间的两扇双开门都会打开（24小时后自动关闭）。

大成功 轮盘旋转2圈。旋转轮盘的DC增加1点。

成功 轮盘旋转1圈。旋转轮盘的DC增加1点。

失败 该角色未能推动轮盘。旋转轮盘的DC增加2点。

大失败 该角色跌跌撞撞失去了对轮盘的控制，触发了耐力试炼危害。轮盘反向转动，圈数重置为0，DC重置为25。

Topple Crates.name: 推翻木箱 Topple Crates
Topple Crates.description:
需求 你与一处箱子堆成的柱子相邻

你尝试将沉重的板条箱推翻并使其倒向一名敌人。尝试@Check[athletics|dc:22]检定。

成功 你将木箱推向处于箱柱@Template[line|distance:15]{15尺线形}范围内的 1 个目标。倒塌的箱子会造成@Damage[(3d10+6)[bludgeoning]]伤害，这需要进行@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic]豁免。豁免大失败的生物还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]。木箱倒塌的所有方格均会成为困难地形（difficult terrain）。

失败 你未能推翻箱子。

大失败 箱子向着你倒了下来，其效果与成功相同，但只影响你和你所占据的方格。

Host Event.name: Host Event
Host Event.description:
You dedicate a day to planning and hosting a special event, such as a feast, a small festival, or a public performance. Doing so requires an expenditure of 250 gp. Attempt a @Check[diplomacy|dc:36], @Check[performance|dc:36], @Check[society|dc:36], or appropriate Lore check. The result determines the impact of your efforts. You gain a cumulative +1 circumstance bonus to this check (maximum +4) for each additional 250 gp you spend on the event.

Critical Success Each PC gains a +2 circumstance bonus to skill checks to perform downtime activities for the next 3 days. Also, reduce the Support Points of two different guilds of your choice by 1.

Success Each PC gains a +1 circumstance bonus to skill checks to perform downtime activities the following day. In addition, reduce the Support Points of one guild of your choice by 1.

Critical Failure The party is a disaster. Each PC takes a -2 circumstance penalty to skill checks to perform downtime activities the following day.

Reposition Chains.name: Reposition Chains
Reposition Chains.description: You pull on the chains, moving a willing chained ally up to 10 feet to a space within your reach.

Petal Dance.name: Petal Dance
Petal Dance.description:
Aspect plant

Activate 2 (concentrate)

Frequency once per hour

Effect You discorporate into a cloud of petals and leaves. This grants you the swarm trait, immunity to falling damage, resistance 5 to bludgeoning and slashing damage, and weakness 5 to area and splash damage. You can fit into spaces only a few inches wide, moving your constituent petals through the gap. You don't gain the swarm mind ability, so you're still affected normally by mental effects. As a swarm, you can't speak, cast spells, use manipulate actions requiring your hands, activate your magic items, or make any of your Strikes with your normal body. You remain in this form for 1 minute or until you Dismiss the activation. At 13th level, the relic gains a reaction that triggers when you fall or take damage, applying this gift's resistances, weaknesses, and immunity to falling damage to the triggering effect.

Azata's Grace.name: Azata's Grace
Azata's Grace.description:
Aspect celestial

Activate 2 command, Interact

Frequency once per day

Effect Monarch opens a conduit to Desna's palace of Cynosure and infuses your soul with the grace of the azatas who dance and frolic therein. You gain 50 additional Hit Points, increasing both your maximum and current Hit Points, as well as weakness 10 to lawful damage. You also gain the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.adventure-specific-actions.Item.EbF9U21iMu0JkTzG]{Righteous Call} gift, without expending that gift's daily use.

You can Dismiss the effect. If you do so, you unleash a wave of chaotic power in the form of a rainbow-like pulse of light, causing the relic to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uEyfLoFQsRKBRIcB]{Confusing Colors}. The effects of this casting of scintillating pattern don't affect your allies.

Pierce the Veil.name: Pierce the Veil
Pierce the Veil.description:
Aspect death

Prerequisite living death gift

The relic allows you to pierce the veil between life and death. While you are holding or wearing the relic, you have the void healing ability (as though you were undead; vitality energy harms you and void energy heals you). In addition, whenever you are healed by a void spell or effect, you gain resistance 5 to all damage (except force, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]{Ghost Touch}, spirit, and vitality) until the start of your next turn. Finally, you gain a +2 item bonus to all saves against death effects while you are the bearer of the relic; this increases to a +3 item bonus at 13th level.

Dematerialize.name: Dematerialize
Dematerialize.description:
Frequency once per day

You cause your body to flicker and fade, becoming truly ghostlike in appearance and becoming unable to touch or to be touched in turn. You become incorporeal for 1 round and can Sustain this effect for up to 5 rounds.

Post Snipers.name: 派驻神射手 Post Snipers
Post Snipers.description:
纳玛彻斯守林人都是熟练的猎手，但PC将其中的一些弓箭手从军队中抽掉出来，安置在战场中的屋顶和树上的隐蔽位置，就可以最大限度地发挥出他们的潜力。

大成功 神射手部署在了几个关键位置。泰兹尔滩战斗的每一轮结束时，尝试对任何未接战的军队进行[[/r 1d20+18 #Ranged Strike]]{+18}远程打击。神箭手每次命中造成1点伤害（重击造成2点伤害）。神箭手在泰兹尔滩战斗中最多可以进行3次额外攻击，但在任何一轮结束时都只能攻击一次。

成功 类似大成功，但神箭手在战斗中只能进行一次额外攻击。

大失败 不仅没能将神箭手派驻在具有优势的区域，而且PC从军队中抽调了太多弓箭手。在泰兹尔滩战役中，纳玛彻斯猎人进行远程攻击会受到-2减值。

Ancestors' Call.name: Ancestors' Call
Ancestors' Call.description:
Aspect mind

Dwarven spirits gravitate toward this relic, and you can call upon them to inhabit you and your allies to impart ancestral secrets. When you gain this gift, choose three common 1st-level dwarf ancestry feats.

Activate 1 envision

Frequency once per hour

Effect Select one of the three ancestry feats. You and each ally in a 10-foot-radius burst centered on you gain that feat and the dwarf trait for 1 minute.

Propelling Winds.name: 推进之风 Propelling Winds
Propelling Winds.description:
性相 气

启动 2 命令，交互

频率 每小时一次

效果 圣物以你为目标施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.A2JfEKe6BZcTG1S8]。

Ripples and Waves.name: Ripples and Waves
Ripples and Waves.description:
Aspect water

You become attuned to the ebb and flow of all things, as if embodying water itself. You gain wavesense 60 feet as a precise sense and can cast 5th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jfVCuOpzC6mUrf6f]{Hydraulic Push} at will as an innate spell.

Activate 2 (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect Ankle-deep water floods outward from you, filling a @Template[emanation|distance:60] centered on you for 1 minute. Enemies within the area without a swim Speed treat the area as difficult terrain for movement on land. While the effect persists, you can have any water effects you generate originate from any point within the emanation, in addition to their normal range and area.

Build Workshop (Crafting).name: Build Workshop (Crafting)
Build Workshop (Crafting).description:
Requirements Crafting (master), Specialty Crafting (any), or any hired specialist; organized specialists

Pick a room in Citadel Altaerein to serve as a crafting area for a specific Crafting skill chosen from one of the crafting specialties listed under the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.QLeMH5mQgh28sa5o]{Specialty Crafting} feat. You can have multiple workshops, each devoted to its own skill. Use of a workshop grants a +1 circumstance bonus to Crafting checks, or a +3 circumstance bonus to Crafting skill checks associated with that workshop's specialty. This upgrade takes 20 days of work to complete and a @Check[crafting|dc:25] check.

De-Animating Gestures (False).name: 解除动力手势 De-Animating Gestures （假）
De-Animating Gestures (False).description: 指定一个在30尺内你能看到或听到的构装体。这个构装体会获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{迅捷 Quickened 1}，持续1分钟，并在24小时内免疫该效果。它只能用它的额外动作来行走或打击。

De-Animating Gestures (True).name: 解除动力手势 De-Animating Gestures （真）
De-Animating Gestures (True).description: 你指定一个在30尺内你能看到或听到的构装体。这个构装体会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 Slowed 1}，持续1分钟。

Locked Doors.name: Locked Doors
Locked Doors.description:
Overcome 2 successes; @Check[athletics|dc:35],@Check[thievery|dc:35]

Most of the manor is locked to prevent guests from wandering into restricted areas. The PCs quietly break into rooms or unlock doors.

Recruit Wildlife.name: 招募野兽 Recruit Wildlife
Recruit Wildlife.description:
泰兹尔滩周围的森林里有着数量相当多的野兽。虽然没法将这些动物组织成一支真正的军队，但PC依然可以使用自己的技能将当地的动物族群转化为自身优势。招募野兽需要进行自然（专家）检定。如果PC有荒野认同专长，或者可以施展动物交谈法术，他们也可以选择用交涉（受训）来进行这项检定。

大成功 PC解释了动物对敌军接近的反应。友方军队在泰兹尔滩战斗中进行先攻检定时获得+3环境加值。此外，一群饥饿的狐尾袋狼会在战斗中的某个时刻袭击敌军。这次攻击发生在由玩家选择的某个回合结束之时，此时PC可以尝试对任何未接战的军队进行[[/r {1d20+20} #melee strike]]{+20}近战打击。在动物逃回树林之前，袋狼的打击命中会对敌军造成1点伤害（重击则为2点）。

成功 类似大成功（包括袋狼攻击），但先攻检定的环境加值仅为+1。

大失败 当地的动物不仅拒绝援助，而且PC的动作还意外地导致一群疯狂的袋狼来到镇上进行攻击。泰兹尔滩城镇守卫成功击败了进攻，但他们会以受到1点伤害的状态开始战争遭遇。

Sap Life.name: Sap Life
Sap Life.description: Just as some undead hunger for life, you feel the urge to draw vitality from the living. Attempt an unarmed Strike against a foe. If you hit, you inflict @Damage[4d6[void]] damage and restore @Damage[10[healing]] Hit Points to yourself.

Tide of Death.name: Tide of Death
Tide of Death.description:
Aspect death

Prerequisite death gaze gift

You can Activate @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.adventure-specific-actions.Item.d8zThGz5nW3rL7vC]{Death Gaze} with 3 actions instead of 2. If you do, it targets all living creatures within 30 feet except for you. If you have the void healing ability, you can include yourself to be healed.

Tidal Crash.name: Tidal Crash
Tidal Crash.description:
Aspect water

Activate 2 (concentrate)

Effect Your relic spews forth a dense sphere of water. Make a spell attack roll against a target within 30 feet. On a success, you deal @Damage[2d10[bludgeoning]] damage plus [[/r (2[splash])[bludgeoning]]]{2 bludgeoning splash damage}. At 3rd level and every 2 levels thereafter, increase the initial damage by 1d10 and the splash damage by 1.

Feral Claws.name: Feral Claws
Feral Claws.description:
Aspect beast

Prerequisite The relic is a worn item

Activate 1 (concentrate)

Effect Your hands transform into a pair of claws. These grant you a claw unarmed attack that deals 1d6 slashing damage and has the agile and finesse traits. This lasts until you Dismiss the effect.

Prepare Firepots.name: 准备火盆 Prepare Firepots
Prepare Firepots.description:
由于得知敌军中农有一些巨魔，准备装有炽火胶、油或者其他能快速燃烧的材料的火盆可能会对战斗非常有帮助。准备火盆需要进行手艺（受训）检定。

大成功 制造了足够多的火盆，在战场上的任何地点都能快速取用，因此攻击泰兹尔滩的巨魔军队失去再生战术。

成功 没能制造出足够多确保能快速部署的火盆。在巨魔军队的回合结束时，它必须进行DC20的机动检定。如果失败它将在下一轮结束前失去再生战术。

大失败 准备火盆导致了一场壮观的爆炸，对PC造成@Damage[10d6[fire]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic]豁免）。

Uniter of Clans Enhancement.name: Uniter of Clans Enhancement
Uniter of Clans Enhancement.description: Increase the diplomat's badge's item bonus to Diplomacy to +2 for the Uniter of Clans.

Deadly Spark.name: 致命火花 Deadly Spark
Deadly Spark.description:
性相 气

启动 2 专注，操作

效果 圣物对20尺内的敌人发射一道电火花，造成@Damage[(1+max(0,floor((@actor.level -2)/4)))d12[electricity]]伤害（@Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic]豁免）。该伤害在6级时增加1d12，之后每4级增加1d12。

Passion.name: Passion
Passion.description:
Even in death, the flames of excitement burn hot. Be it the result of ignited enthusiasm or burning anger inspired by love for another or something more, the chill of the grave can't quench the hero's emotions. You kindle your passion into actual flames for 1 minute. During this time, your body is engulfed in fire of a color of your choice that sheds bright light in a 40-foot radius (and dim light to the next 40 feet). Your melee Strikes inflict an additional 1d6 fire damage, you gain fire resistance 10, and you gain the following reaction.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.adventure-specific-actions.Item.kfmEGGs8DbIL9JuF]{Reactive Scorch}

Love.name: Love
Love.description: A powerful and all-consuming devotion, love for another can sometimes reach them beyond the grave. Romantic, familial, or platonic love can be the driving force behind this focus. It expresses itself as an aura of empathy for animals, who are sensitive toward otherworldly beings and easier to influence with ghostly emotions than more logical creatures. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals. When you're within 30 feet of a trusted ally (such as another PC), you gain a +1 status bonus to Will saving throws. This increases to a +2 status bonus if a trusted ally you love is within this range.

Seasonal Boon (Folklore Enthusiast).name: 季节恩惠-民俗爱好者 Seasonal Boon (Folklore Enthusiast)
Seasonal Boon (Folklore Enthusiast).description:
频率 每个季节一次

触发 你将要为回忆知识做出任意检定

效果 你具有一种洞察力，随着你回忆起了一个古老的寓言，模糊的传说，或适合手头主题的故事。此次回忆知识失去秘密特征。提高一级你回忆知识检定结果的成功度。

Blend In.name: Blend In
Blend In.description:
Overcome @Check[deception|dc:35], @Check[society|dc:37], @Check[stealth|dc:35]

Sometimes the best option for crossing a crowded party is to act natural and join the crowd.

If a PC successfully Blends In, roll a secret @Check[perception|dc:34|traits:secret] for them to notice that something seems off about one of the guests. On a success, inform them about the Dispel a Disguise Opportunity.

Rescue Citizens.name: Rescue Citizens
Rescue Citizens.description:
You focus your efforts on helping citizens escape or recover from wounds. Attempt a @Check[diplomacy|dc:36] or @Check[intimidation|dc:36] check to direct citizens to safety, a @Check[medicine|dc:38] check to treat injured survivors, or a @Check[society|dc:40] check to know about unusual escape routes to safety from the building and the surrounding alleys.

Critical Success Your efforts are resoundingly successful. Roll [[/r {2d6}]]{2d6}-this is the number of citizens trapped in the building who you lead to safety or the number of citizens who succumbed during this or the previous phase who you've managed to nurse back to life from the brink of death, split any way you wish.

Success You rescue [[/r 1d6 #Citizens Rescued]]{1d6 citizens} from the flames.

Failure You fail to rescue any citizens from the fire and take @Damage[2d6[fire]] damage.

Critical Failure You take @Damage[4d6[fire]] damage as a blast of fire and falling debris strikes you. For every 5 fire damage you take from this, one citizen still trapped in the building perishes

Dancing Shadow.name: 舞动之影 Dancing Shadow
Dancing Shadow.description:
性相 阴影

先决条件 圣物是一件武器

启动 2 命令，交互

频率 每小时一次

效果 你的圣物的影子从武器上分离，在空中舞动着攻击敌人。当你启动圣物时，指定一个目标。圣物的影子能飞到最远60尺远距离，直到它和那个敌人相邻，然后对目标进行一次打击，命中时造成5d8伤害，重击时造成双倍伤害；伤害类型通常是你的圣物能造成的任何伤害类型。影子武器使用你持握圣物时的攻击加值，使用且会增加你的多重攻击减值。当此效果激活时，你能使用一个具有攻击和专注特征的单动作，以精神引导影子对同一个目标进行另一次打击。影子武器会一直持续直到目标生命值减少至0，或直到目标距离你超过400尺，或直到目标移动到一个没有阴影的地方，例如完全黑暗的区域，以先发生的情况为准。

影子武器不占据空间，不提供夹击，也不拥有任何生物所具有的其他属性，它会自动跟随所选择的目标。除了它本来具有的打击之外，影子武器无法进行其他方式的攻击。影响武器的专长或法术对它不起作用。

Influence Regent.name: 影响摄政者 Influence Regent
Influence Regent.description:
你试图获得一名寇夫拉的摄政者的青睐，可以选择得体并尊重地回应他们的问题，这需要尝试一次交涉检定；或者你也可以利用在其他技能上的聪明才智。第二种策略通常无法成功，除非该技能刚好是这名摄政者的行会所偏好技能。根据 GM 的判断，你也可以使用合适的学识（Lore）技能来替代交涉检定。若你尝试交涉或学识检定，需要通过@Check[diplomacy|dc:32]或@Check[lore|dc:32]检定才能成功；若你尝试的是行会偏好技能的检定，则通过@Check[diplomacy|dc:28]或@Check[lore|dc:28]检定便可以成功。

根据 GM 的判断，若角色在影响摄政者的尝试中提出了令人信服的观点或者进行了让人印象深刻的扮演，则可以在该检定中获得+2 环境加值。

大成功 你让摄政者的疑虑降低了 2 点

成功 你让摄政者的疑虑降低了 1 点

失败 你未能改变摄政者的疑虑

大失败 你让摄政者的疑虑增加了 1 点

Set Traps.name: 设置陷阱 Set Traps
Set Traps.description:
PC 可以在周围的树林或狭窄的小巷中设置一些快速搭建的陷阱来阻碍进攻方的行动，甚至对他们造成伤害。设置陷阱需要进行生存（受训）检定。

大成功 泰兹尔滩战斗的每一轮结束时，PC选择一支敌军使其获得迟滞1，并且使其受到1点伤害。

成功 泰兹尔滩战斗的每一轮结束时，PC选择一支敌军使其获得迟滞1或者使其受到1点伤害。

大失败 设置陷阱的尝试不仅失败了，而且还误触了其中一个在设置过程的陷阱：尝试将一根镶满尖钉的圆木设置成陷阱的动作失败了，把PC撞向一栋建筑的墙上。该PC受到@Damage[5d6[piercing],5d6[bludgeoning]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic]豁免）。

Cunning Disguise.name: Cunning Disguise
Cunning Disguise.description:
Overcome @Check[deception|dc:35] or DC 33 (see below)

The PCs conceal their true identities, relying on false personas to be admitted onto the estate. A PC can use a skill closely connected to their chosen disguise in place of Deception, such as Intimidation for a guard, Guild Lore for a merchant, or any food-related Lore for a caterer.

If a PC succeeds at a Cunning Disguise, roll a secret @Check[perception|dc:34|traits:secret] for them to notice something off about one of the guests. On a success, inform them about the Dispel a Disguise Opportunity.

Issue Challenge.name: Issue Challenge
Issue Challenge.description:
You spend a day promoting your combat abilities, trash-talking the competition, calling out the leadership of the Gladiators' Guild, or performing public feats of bravado to compel the guildmaster of the Gladiators' Guild to accept your challenge to rule over the arena. This action ties specifically into Task 3: Blood on the Sand. Attempt a @Check[athletics|dc:36], @Check[deception|dc:36], @Check[intimidation|dc:36], @Check[performance|dc:36], or appropriate Lore skill check.

Critical Success You provoke Bshez Shak into accepting your challenge.

Success You weaken Bshez's resolve. For the next 7 days, your checks to Issue Challenges gain a cumulative +1 circumstance bonus (maximum +4).

Critical Failure Your boisterousness accidentally leads to embarrassment that undermines your stature. You lose any circumstance bonuses you've earned as a result of successful Issued Challenges, and can't Issue a Challenge the next day.
